french: Les Caldosiens... et les Aldariens.
russian: Кальдосийцы... и альдарийцы.
bulgarian: Caldosians... and the Aldarians.

english: Descendants of those who lived and worshiped here during my time, I am sure of it.
french: Les descendants de ceux qui ont vécu et m'ont adoré en ce lieu à mon époque, j'en suis convaincu.
russian: Это потомки тех, кто молился в этом месте в моё время. Я уверен.
bulgarian: Descendants of those who lived and worshiped here during my time, I am sure of it.

english: And yet, those who would become the Caldosians sailed east to form their empire while the Alda remained to found Aldaria. Why...?
french: Pourtant, ceux qui allaient devenir les Caldosiens ont navigué vers l'est pour constituer leur empire, tandis que ceux d'Alda restaient pour fonder Aldaria. Pourquoi...?
russian: И всё же, по какой-то причине кальдосийцы отправились на восток, чтобы основать собственную империю, в то время как альдийцы остались и основали Альдарию. Почему?...
bulgarian: And yet, those who would become the Caldosians sailed east to form their empire while the Alda remained to found Aldaria. Why...?

english: Ah, my head is beginning to hurt. Perhaps that is enough reading for today.
french: Ah, je commence à avoir mal à la tête. J'ai peut-être assez lu pour aujourd'hui.
russian: Ах, моя голова начинает болеть. Кажется, достаточно чтения на сегодня.
bulgarian: Ah, my head is beginning to hurt. Perhaps that is enough reading for today.

english: Fascinating...
french: C'est fascinant...
russian: Поразительно...
bulgarian: Fascinating...

english: "The Caldosians and the Aldarians are known to share a common ancestral origin."
bulgarian: "The Caldosians and the Aldarians are known to share a common ancestral origin."

english: Caldosians... and the Aldarians.
bulgarian: Caldosians... and the Aldarians.

english: Descendants of those who lived and worshiped here during Seridia's reign.
bulgarian: Descendants of those who lived and worshiped here during Seridia's reign.

english: The common people remained in this land, eventually forming Aldaria. Seridia's nobility sailed east and became the Caldosian Empire.
bulgarian: The common people remained in this land, eventually forming Aldaria. Seridia's nobility sailed east and became the Caldosian Empire.

english: One can only wonder how those nobles managed to survive such a journey, having been completely dependent on $Magic$ up until that point.
bulgarian: One can only wonder how those nobles managed to survive such a journey, having been completely dependent on $Magic$ up until that point.

english: Ah, my head is beginning to hurt. Perhaps that is enough reading for today.
bulgarian: Ah, my head is beginning to hurt. Perhaps that is enough reading for today.

english: All the pieces are coming together...
bulgarian: All the pieces are coming together...

english: I thought that I remembered something last night.
french: J'ai cru m'être souvenu de quelque chose, la nuit dernière.
russian: Прошлой ночью мне показалось, что я что-то вспомнил.
bulgarian: I thought that I remembered something last night.

english: A vision of sorts. Red flames, red eyes...
french: Une sorte de vision. Des flammes rouges, des yeux rouges...
russian: Мне пришло что-то вроде видения. Красное пламя, красные глаза...
bulgarian: A vision of sorts. Red flames, red eyes...

english: Perhaps it was just a dream.
french: Ce n'était peut-être qu'un rêve.
russian: Возможно, это был лишь сон.
bulgarian: Perhaps it was just a dream.

english: Ah, [Ari]. It is hard to concentrate today.
french: Ah, [Ari]. J'ai du mal à me concentrer aujourd'hui.
russian: Ах, [Ari]. Сегодня мне сложно сосредоточиться.
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]. It is hard to concentrate today.

english: (Caldarus seems engrossed in his music. You probably shouldn't disturb him.)
french: (Caldarus semble plongé dans sa musique. Mieux vaut éviter de le déranger.)
russian: (Кальдарус увлечён музыкой. Вероятно, его не стоит беспокоить.)
bulgarian: (Caldarus seems engrossed in his music. You probably shouldn't disturb him.)

english: (Caldarus' claws play delicately along the strings of his lute. It's mesmerizing.)
french: (Caldarus joue délicatement des cordes de son luth avec ses griffes. C'est hypnotisant.)
russian: (Когти Кальдаруса осторожно скользят по струнам лютни. Это завораживает.)
bulgarian: (Caldarus' claws play delicately along the strings of his lute. It's mesmerizing.)

english: (You don't recognize the song Caldarus plays. It's unlike anything you've ever heard.)
french: (Vous ne reconnaissez pas la musique que joue Caldarus. Elle ne ressemble à rien de ce que vous avez déjà entendu.)
russian: (Мелодия, которую Кальдарус играет, не известна вам. Она не похожа ни на что прежде вами слышанное.)
bulgarian: (You don't recognize the song Caldarus plays. It's unlike anything you've ever heard.)

english: (Caldarus plays a lovingly preserved lute. It's a different design than Hemlock's, and made from a wood you don't recognize.)
french: (Caldarus joue d'un luth dont il a pris grand soin. Il n'a pas la même forme que ceux d'Hemlock et il est fabriqué dans un bois que vous ne reconnaissez pas.)
russian: (Кальдарус играет на прекрасно сохранившейся лютне. Её дизайн отличается от лютни Хемлока, она сделана из не знакомой вам древесины.)
bulgarian: (Caldarus plays a lovingly preserved lute. It's a different design than Hemlock's, and made from a wood you don't recognize.)

english: (There's an impenetrable melancholy to the way Caldarus is playing his lute. It's hard to find the right moment to get his attention...)
french: (Il y a dans la façon dont Caldarus joue du luth une insondable mélancolie. Difficile de trouver le bon moment pour attirer son attention...)
russian: (В игре Кальдаруса чувствуется непроницаемая меланхолия. Сложно подобрать момент, чтобы привлечь его внимание...)
bulgarian: (There's an impenetrable melancholy to the way Caldarus is playing his lute. It's hard to find the right moment to get his attention...)

english: (Caldarus plucks light, happy notes from his lute. He seems to be enjoying himself... probably better not to bother him for the time being.)
french: (Caldarus tire de son luth des notes joyeuses et légères. Il semble s'amuser... Sans doute vaut-il mieux éviter de le déranger pour le moment.)
russian: (Кальдарус играет на лютне лёгкие, радостные ноты. Кажется, ему доставляет это удовольствие... Возможно, не стоит его пока отвлекать.)
bulgarian: (Caldarus plucks light, happy notes from his lute. He seems to be enjoying himself... probably better not to bother him for the time being.)

english: (Caldarus studies his lute with lidded eyes. His gaze follows his claws as they move along the strings.)
french: (Caldarus examine son luth, les yeux mi-clos. Il suit du regard ses griffes qui bougent sur les cordes.)
russian: (Кальдарус тщательно изучает лютню в своих руках. Его прикрытые глаза следуют за его когтями, скользящими по струнам.)
bulgarian: (Caldarus studies his lute with lidded eyes. His gaze follows his claws as they move along the strings.)

english: It took but a glance to know that Celine is the keeper of these grounds.
french: Il ne m'a fallu qu'un coup d'œil pour savoir que Céline entretenait ces jardins.
russian: Я с первого взгляда понял, что этот сад — дело рук Селин.
bulgarian: It took but a glance to know that Celine is the keeper of these grounds.

english: Those who tend plants leave their signature behind...
french: Ceux qui s'occupent des plantes laissent une trace de leur passage...
russian: У каждого, кто ухаживает за растениями, есть собственный почерк...
bulgarian: Those who tend plants leave their signature behind...

english: Perhaps I can help Celine care for them in the coming seasons.
french: Peut-être pourrais-je aider Céline à s'en occuper dans les saisons à venir.
russian: Возможно, в будущем я смогу помочь Селин за ним ухаживать.
bulgarian: Perhaps I can help Celine care for them in the coming seasons.

english: While I favor nature's wilder state, I must concede that these gardens are very beautiful.
french: Bien que j'aie une préférence pour une nature plus sauvage, je dois admettre qu'ils sont très beaux.
russian: Я предпочитаю более дикую природу, однако не могу не отметить красоту этого сада.
bulgarian: While I favor nature's wilder state, I must concede that these gardens are very beautiful.

english: You could fit at least two dragons inside of it. Comfortably, even.
french: Elle pourrait abriter au moins deux dragons. Confortablement, de surcroît.
russian: В нём можно расположить по меньшей мере двух драконов. И даже не будет тесно.
bulgarian: You could fit at least two dragons inside of it. Comfortably, even.

english: This is an impressive house.
french: Cette maison est impressionnante.
russian: Какой величественный дом.
bulgarian: This is an impressive house.

english: Your $Watering Can$ should be useful for $traversing pools of magma$.
french: Ton $arrosoir$ devrait t'être utile pour $franchir les bassins de lave$.
russian: Твоя $лейка$ может помочь $пройти по озёрам лавы$.
bulgarian: Your $Watering Can$ should be useful for $traversing pools of magma$.

english: Of course, you could also use the $Summon Rain$ spell I bestowed to you as well!
french: Bien sûr, tu pourrais également utiliser le sort $Danse de la pluie$ que je t'ai octroyé !
russian: Конечно, ты также можешь использовать заклинание $Призыв дождя$, которое я тебе даровал!
bulgarian: Of course, you could also use the $Summon Rain$ spell I bestowed to you as well!

english: The $Lava Caves$ in the Mines...
french: Les $Grottes de laves$, dans les mines...
russian: Насчёт $лавовых пещер$ в шахтах...
bulgarian: The $Lava Caves$ in the Mines...

english: Still, it is a pleasure to be able to look my best. Especially after all that time as an old statue!
french: Il n'empêche, c'est un plaisir de soigner mon apparence. Surtout après tout ce temps passé sous forme d'une vieille statue !
russian: И всё же для меня выглядеть красиво — большое удовольствие. Особенно после стольких лет в обличье статуи!
bulgarian: Still, it is a pleasure to be able to look my best. Especially after all that time as an old statue!

english: My morning talons, tail, and horns routine has become quite lengthy.
french: Ma routine matinale pour soigner mes griffes, ma queue et mes cornes me prend pas mal de temps.
russian: Мой утренний уход за когтями, хвостом и рогами в последнее время занимает много времени.
bulgarian: My morning talons, tail, and horns routine has become quite lengthy.

english: In some ways, it is... difficult.
french: Par certains aspects, cela m'est... difficile.
russian: Это в некотором роде... непросто.
bulgarian: In some ways, it is... difficult.

english: Walking these halls, it highlights how much time passed as I slept...
french: Parcourir ces salles souligne tout le temps qui s'est écoulé durant mon sommeil...
russian: Обходя музейные залы, я отмечаю, как много времени прошло, пока я спал...
bulgarian: Walking these halls, it highlights how much time passed as I slept...

english: Their cleverness always delights me, but never surprises me.
french: Leur ingéniosité me ravit toujours, sans toutefois me surprendre.
russian: Я всегда впечатляюсь их находчивости, хотя никогда не удивляюсь.
bulgarian: Their cleverness always delights me, but never surprises me.

english: They are capable of greatness in many ways.
french: Ils sont, de bien des façons, capables de grandeur.
russian: Они способны на самые разные великие дела.
bulgarian: They are capable of greatness in many ways.

english: Mortals accomplished much while I slept.
french: Les mortels ont accompli tant de choses pendant que je dormais.
russian: За время моего сна смертные достигли очень многого.
bulgarian: Mortals accomplished much while I slept.

english: At a glance it is not so different from Seridia's hoard...
french: À première vue, cela n'est guère différent de l'accumulation de richesses de Seridia...
russian: На первый взгляд она может напоминать сокровища Серидиии...
bulgarian: At a glance it is not so different from Seridia's hoard...

english: But their intention colors this treasure trove quite differently.
french: Mais l'intention qui est la leur donne à ce trésor une couleur bien différente.
russian: Однако, учитывая их намерения, эти ценности предстают в ином свете.
bulgarian: But their intention colors this treasure trove quite differently.

english: Eiland and Errol have amassed an impressive collection for their museum.
french: Eiland et Errol ont accumulé une collection impressionnante pour leur musée.
russian: Эйланд и Эррол собрали в музее впечатляющую коллекцию.
bulgarian: Eiland and Errol have amassed an impressive collection for their museum.

english: It is a joy to study its many forms.
french: C'est une joie d'en étudier les nombreuses formes.
russian: Мне приятно изучать её множественные воплощения.
bulgarian: It is a joy to study its many forms.

english: The forest teems with life...
french: La forêt grouille de vie...
russian: Этот лес полон жизни...
bulgarian: The forest teems with life...

english: The quality of light here is beautiful, is it not?
french: La lumière n'est-elle pas magnifique ici ?
russian: Свет здесь по-настоящему прекрасен, не так ли?
bulgarian: The quality of light here is beautiful, is it not?

english: It is the sound of home.
french: C'est là le chant du foyer.
russian: Звучит, как дом.
bulgarian: It is the sound of home.

english: The night songs of these forest insects...
french: Le chant nocturne de ces insectes forestiers...
russian: Ночное пение лесных насекомых...
bulgarian: The night songs of these forest insects...

english: Perhaps some foraging is in order.
french: Peut-être devrais-je aller faire une cueillette.
russian: Кажется, сегодня стоит отправиться на сборы.
bulgarian: Perhaps some foraging is in order.

english: There is an herbaceous scent in the air today. Something that smells like it would make a nice seasoning.
french: Il y a dans l'air un parfum herbacé, aujourd'hui. Quelque chose qui, à l'odeur, ferait un assaisonnement agréable.
russian: Сегодня я чувствую вокруг необычный травяной запах. Такой, что источают хорошие приправы.
bulgarian: There is an herbaceous scent in the air today. Something that smells like it would make a nice seasoning.

english: When I am further recovered, I will inquire with the young carpenter for their contemporary names.
french: Quand je serai davantage remis, je m'enquerrai de leur dénomination actuelle auprès du jeune menuisier.
russian: Когда я достаточно оправлюсь, я непременно расспрошу молодого плотника об их современных именах.
bulgarian: When I am further recovered, I will inquire with the young carpenter for their contemporary names.

english: There are quite a variety of birds that inhabit these woods. I am certain I knew their names, once.
french: Une grande diversité d'oiseaux vit dans ces bois. Je suis certain que je connaissais leurs noms, autrefois.
russian: В сих лесах живёт множество разнообразных птиц. Уверен, когда-то я знал названия их всех.
bulgarian: There are quite a variety of birds that inhabit these woods. I am certain I knew their names, once.

english: I will need to inquire with young Ryis to learn more of their contemporary names.
french: Il me faudra m'enquérir auprès du jeune Ryis de leur dénomination actuelle.
russian: Надо будет расспросить Риза, чтобы узнать их современные имена.
bulgarian: I will need to inquire with young Ryis to learn more of their contemporary names.

english: There are quite a variety of birds that inhabit these woods. I know many by their ancient names.
french: Une grande diversité d'oiseaux vit dans ces bois. Je connais beaucoup d'entre eux par leur ancien nom.
russian: В этих лесах живёт множество разнообразных птиц. Многих из них я знаю по древним названиям.
bulgarian: There are quite a variety of birds that inhabit these woods. I know many by their ancient names.

english: Have you taken the time to forage in the Deep Woods? There is much here that cannot be found elsewhere in Mistria.
french: As-tu pris le temps de faire un peu de cueillette et de ramassage à Boissombre ? Il y a beaucoup de choses ici que l'on ne trouve nulle part ailleurs à Mistria.
russian: Доводилось ли тебе заниматься собирательством в Глубокой чаще? В сих лесах можно найти множество плодов, каких нет больше нигде в Мистрии.
bulgarian: Have you taken the time to forage in the Deep Woods? There is much here that cannot be found elsewhere in Mistria.

english: I wonder what they would think if I played it back to them.
french: Je me demande ce qu'ils se diraient si je jouais pour eux en retour.
russian: Интересно, что они подумали бы, сыграй я им мелодию в ответ.
bulgarian: I wonder what they would think if I played it back to them.

english: It is always pleasant to listen to birdsong.
french: Il est toujours agréable d'écouter des chants d'oiseaux.
russian: Мне всегда доставляет удовольствие пение птиц.
bulgarian: It is always pleasant to listen to birdsong.

english: When it falls early, every part sustains the one who felled it. And when it falls late, it nourishes the life that comes after.
french: Quand il tombe tôt, chaque partie de son être aide celui qui l'a fait tomber. Et quand il tombe tard, il nourrit la vie qui vient après lui.
russian: Если оно падает рано — каждая его часть питает того, кто его срубил. Если поздно — оно питает жизнь, что приходит следом.
bulgarian: When it falls early, every part sustains the one who felled it. And when it falls late, it nourishes the life that comes after.

english: A tree is a magnificent thing. It grows quietly, humbly, until it towers above all of creation.
french: Un arbre est une chose splendide. Il pousse sans bruit, humblement, jusqu'à dépasser de sa taille tout le reste de la création.
russian: Дерево — величественное создание. Оно растёт тихо, смиренно, пока не вознесётся над всем мирозданием.
bulgarian: A tree is a magnificent thing. It grows quietly, humbly, until it towers above all of creation.

english: It is natural to fear decay, but decay, too, is natural. Everything grows from the body that came before.
french: La peur de dépérir est naturelle, mais le dépérissement lui aussi est naturel. Toute chose croît à partir du corps qui l'a précédé.
russian: Страх разложения естественнен, но естественно и само разложение. Всё вокруг произрастает на останках былого.
bulgarian: It is natural to fear decay, but decay, too, is natural. Everything grows from the body that came before.

english: It is very beautiful.
french: C'est splendide.
russian: Это прекрасное зрелище.
bulgarian: It is very beautiful.

english: Have you ever seen a sunrise from above the clouds?
french: As-tu déjà observé un lever de soleil en étant au-dessus des nuages ?
russian: Доводилось ли тебе наблюдать рассвет с высоты облаков?
bulgarian: Have you ever seen a sunrise from above the clouds?

english: Strange to find them such a comfort.
french: Comme c'est étrange de puiser en eux un tel réconfort.
russian: Они приносят мне необыкновенное утешение.
bulgarian: Strange to find them such a comfort.

english: I have forgotten much, and yet these pines are familiar to me.
french: J'ai oublié beaucoup de choses, pourtant ces pins me sont familiers.
russian: Я многое забыл, но эти сосны мне знакомы.
bulgarian: I have forgotten much, and yet these pines are familiar to me.

english: It may sound strange, but I found them such a comfort in those times.
french: Cela peut sembler étrange, mais je puisais en eux un grand réconfort, à l'époque.
russian: Возможно, прозвучит странно, но они приносят мне необыкновенное утешение.
bulgarian: It may sound strange, but I found them such a comfort in those times.

english: Even when my memory lagged, these pines remained familiar to me.
french: Même quand ma mémoire me faisait défaut, ces pins m'étaient familiers.
russian: Когда у меня были трудности с памятью, эти сосны всё равно оставались знакомы.
bulgarian: Even when my memory lagged, these pines remained familiar to me.

english: Could it be captured with music?
french: Pourrait-elle être capturée en musique ?
russian: Возможно ли выразить его с помощью музыки?
bulgarian: Could it be captured with music?

english: That breeze, whispering through the branches...
french: Cette brise qui murmure entre les branches...
russian: Ветер, шепчущий сквозь ветви деревьев...
bulgarian: That breeze, whispering through the branches...

english: It always does.
french: Il en est toujours ainsi.
russian: Всегда.
bulgarian: It always does.

english: So deep in the wood, the canopy weaves together. It seems impenetrable, and yet the sun breaks through.
french: Dans une forêt si profonde, la canopée tisse ses branches entre elles. Elle semble impénétrable, pourtant le soleil la transperce.
russian: В глубине леса кроны деревьев кажутся непроницаемыми, но солнечный свет всё-равно находит путь.
bulgarian: So deep in the wood, the canopy weaves together. It seems impenetrable, and yet the sun breaks through.

english: Thank you for visiting.
french: Merci de me rendre visite.
russian: Спасибо за твои визиты.
bulgarian: Thank you for visiting.

english: Talking to you anchors me to this time and place.
french: En parlant avec toi, je m'ancre dans ce lieu et cette époque.
russian: Разговоры с тобой удерживают меня в этом времени и месте.
bulgarian: Talking to you anchors me to this time and place.

english: Despite my... unique appearance, they seem quite adept at acclimating to a new status quo.
french: En dépit de mon aspect... unique, ils semblent prêts à s'adapter à ce nouvel équilibre.
russian: Несмотря на мою... необычную внешность, они легко свыклись с новым положением вещей.
bulgarian: Despite my... unique appearance, they seem quite adept at acclimating to a new status quo.

english: Perhaps a dragon's presence is unremarkable because they already sensed it somewhat while I slept.
french: Peut-être la présence d'un dragon ne les surprend guère, car ils l'avaient déjà perçue durant mon sommeil.
russian: Возможно, близость дракона их не смущает, потому что они уже слегка ощущали её, пока я спал.
bulgarian: Perhaps a dragon's presence is unremarkable because they already sensed it somewhat while I slept.

english: Coming to know the townsfolk of Mistria has been easier than I anticipated.
french: Apprendre à connaître les villageois de Mistria a été plus facile que je l'imaginais.
russian: Знакомство с жителями Мистрии оказалось проще, чем я ожидал.
bulgarian: Coming to know the townsfolk of Mistria has been easier than I anticipated.

english: But now that I may leave by choice and enjoy time with others...
french: Mais puisque j'ai désormais la possibilité d'en partir et de passer du temps avec d'autres...
russian: Но теперь, когда я имею возможность выходить и проводить время в компании...
bulgarian: But now that I may leave by choice and enjoy time with others...

english: Time to myself has become sweeter and more meaningful.
french: Le temps seul m'est encore plus doux et important.
russian: Время, проведённое наедине с собой, стало более приятным и осмысленным.
bulgarian: Time to myself has become sweeter and more meaningful.

english: Due to the circumstances of my waking, I became accustomed to the solitude of the Deep Woods.
french: Les circonstances entourant mon réveil m'ont habitué à la solitude de Boissombre.
russian: Ввиду обстоятельств моего пробуждения я привык находиться один в Глубокой чаще.
bulgarian: Due to the circumstances of my waking, I became accustomed to the solitude of the Deep Woods.

english: Their hospitality is a gift I will not soon forget...
french: Leur hospitalité est un cadeau que je n'oublierai pas de sitôt...
russian: Я нескоро забуду их милостивое гостеприимство...
bulgarian: Their hospitality is a gift I will not soon forget...

english: Not to mention the gift of not having to eat my own cooking.
french: Et ne pas avoir à manger ma propre cuisine est un véritable cadeau.
russian: Не говоря уже о том, что они избавили меня от необходимости есть еду, которую я приготовил.
bulgarian: Not to mention the gift of not having to eat my own cooking.

english: So many of my new neighbors have graciously invited me into their homes. They have even insisted on setting a place for me at their tables.
french: Parmi mes nouveaux voisins, beaucoup m'ont gracieusement invité chez eux. Ils ont même insisté pour me faire une place à leur table.
russian: Множество моих новых соседей любезно приглашали меня в свои дома. Они даже настаивали, чтобы я присоединился к ним за столом.
bulgarian: So many of my new neighbors have graciously invited me into their homes. They have even insisted on setting a place for me at their tables.

english: It reconnects you with the life around and within you.
french: Elle permet de se reconnecter avec la vie, autour de soi et en soi.
russian: Помогает воссоединять своё внутреннее начало с окружающей жизнью.
bulgarian: It reconnects you with the life around and within you.

english: A walk in nature yields many benefits.
french: Une marche dans la nature apporte de nombreux bénéfices.
russian: Прогулка на природе приносит большую пользу.
bulgarian: A walk in nature yields many benefits.

english: The fruit and vegetables you have lovingly nurtured would surely like to return the favor.
french: Les fruits et les légumes que tu as fait pousser avec amour voudraient sans doute te rendre la pareille.
russian: Фрукты и овощи, которые ты взращиваешь с любовью, несомненно хотели бы вернуть долг.
bulgarian: The fruit and vegetables you have lovingly nurtured would surely like to return the favor.

english: Are you eating well, [Ari]?
french: Te nourris-tu bien, [Ari] ?
russian: Ты хорошо питаешься, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Are you eating well, [Ari]?

english: Have you greeted your fellows today? It is important to cultivate bonds with the ones who are important to you.
french: As-tu salué tes compagnons aujourd'hui ? Il est important de cultiver des liens avec les personnes qui comptent pour toi.
russian:
Общались

ОбщаласьОбщалсяОбщалось ли ты сегодня со своими товарищами? Поддержание связей с тем, кто тебе дорог, — важное дело.
bulgarian: Have you greeted your fellows today? It is important to cultivate bonds with the ones who are important to you.

english: Even a dragon must mind the changing of the seasons. There are some things bigger than all of us.
french: Même un dragon doit se préoccuper du changement des saisons. Certaines choses dépassent chacun de nous.
russian: Даже дракону приходится следить за сменой сезонов. Некоторые вещи в этом мире значительнее любого из нас.
bulgarian: Even a dragon must mind the changing of the seasons. There are some things bigger than all of us.

english: It may be of no concern now, but as civilizations grow they can exceed the ability of nature to replenish itself.
french: Cela ne nous concerne peut-être pas pour l'instant, mais à mesure que les civilisations croissent, elles peuvent dépasser les capacités de la nature à se reconstituer.
russian: Возможно, сейчас это не кажется важным, но цивилизация, развиваясь, может обогнать способность природы к самовосполнению.
bulgarian: It may be of no concern now, but as civilizations grow they can exceed the ability of nature to replenish itself.

english: When we take from nature, we must be mindful to return in kind.
french: Nous devons être attentifs à rendre à la nature autant que ce que nous lui prenons.
russian: Когда мы что-то забираем у природы, нам следует равноценно восполнить взятое.
bulgarian: When we take from nature, we must be mindful to return in kind.

english: I am trying to internalize that lesson, myself.
french: J'essaie personnellement de faire mien cet enseignement.
russian: Я и сам стараюсь усвоить сей урок.
bulgarian: I am trying to internalize that lesson, myself.

english: Nature teaches us many lessons, such as resilience in the face of hardship.
french: La nature nous enseigne beaucoup de choses, comme la capacité de résister à l'adversité.
russian: Природа может многому нас научить. Например, устойчивости к невзгодам.
bulgarian: Nature teaches us many lessons, such as resilience in the face of hardship.

english: There is something beautiful about the act of cultivating the earth.
french: Il y a quelque chose de magnifique dans l'acte de cultiver la terre.
russian: В возделывании земли есть что-то поистине прекрасное.
bulgarian: There is something beautiful about the act of cultivating the earth.

english: Time changes all things.
french: Le temps fait évoluer toute chose.
russian: Время меняет всё.
bulgarian: Time changes all things.

english: One must be mindful not to take every ancient pearl of wisdom at face value.
french: Il faut veiller à ne pas prendre chaque sage parole de jadis au pied de la lettre.
russian: Не всякую древнюю мудрость следует воспринимать буквально. Каждую стоит подвергать критике.
bulgarian: One must be mindful not to take every ancient pearl of wisdom at face value.

english: At the time I did not understand such a need. The memory of a dragon is quite long.
french: À l'époque, je ne comprenais pas quel besoin il y avait à cela. Les dragons ont une mémoire très longue.
russian: В то время я не придавал этому значения, ведь память дракона очень объёмна.
bulgarian: At the time I did not understand such a need. The memory of a dragon is quite long.

english: But now, I am grateful for it.
french: Mais à présent, je leur en suis reconnaissant.
russian: Но теперь я благодарен им за это.
bulgarian: But now, I am grateful for it.

english: Long ago, the Dragon Priestesses labored to formulate a parchment that would last through the ages.
french: Il y a bien longtemps, les prêtresses dragon ont appris à fabriquer un parchemin capable de traverser les âges.
russian: Давным-давно жрицы дракона много работали, чтобы создать пергамент, способный продержаться сквозь века.
bulgarian: Long ago, the Dragon Priestesses labored to formulate a parchment that would last through the ages.

english: One must handle a scroll carefully when one has claws.
french: Il faut manipuler les parchemins avec beaucoup de soin quand on a des griffes.
russian: Когда на твоих руках когти, со свитками приходится обращаться крайне осторожно.
bulgarian: One must handle a scroll carefully when one has claws.

english: If only there was a way to show you... the drawings are quite amusing.
french: Si seulement il existait un moyen pour que je te les montre... Les dessins sont très amusants.
russian: Как бы мне хотелось найти способ показать их тебе... эти рисунки достаточно занимательны.
bulgarian: If only there was a way to show you... the drawings are quite amusing.

english: Many of these scrolls have illustrations in the margin. The ink is only visible to the eye of a dragon, though.
french: Les marges de bon nombre de ces rouleaux sont illustrées. L'encre n'est en revanche visible qu'aux yeux des dragons.
russian: На краях многих из этих свитков есть иллюстрации. Но они нарисованы чернилами, которые может увидеть лишь драконий глаз.
bulgarian: Many of these scrolls have illustrations in the margin. The ink is only visible to the eye of a dragon, though.

english: They would surely scold me if they saw the haphazard manner in which I have been shelving them.
french: Elles me gronderaient sans doute si elles voyaient de quelle manière désordonnée je les ai disposés sur mes étagères.
russian: Если бы они увидели, с каким пренебрежением к системе я раскладываю свитки по разным полкам, они бы меня непременно отчитали.
bulgarian: They would surely scold me if they saw the haphazard manner in which I have been shelving them.

english: I imagine the Dragon Priestesses must have been in charge of keeping this library of scrolls organized, because I am hopeless at it.
french: Je suppose que les prêtresses dragon étaient chargées de veiller à l'organisation de cette bibliothèque de parchemins, car j'en suis, pour ma part, bien incapable.
russian: Надо думать, организацией этой библиотеки свитков занимались жрицы дракона. Самому мне это даётся с трудом.
bulgarian: I imagine the Dragon Priestesses must have been in charge of keeping this library of scrolls organized, because I am hopeless at it.

english: Someday, I should like to pay a visit to your museum's archive.
french: J'aimerais un jour me rendre dans les archives de votre musée.
russian: Однажды мне хотелось бы посетить архив вашего музея.
bulgarian: Someday, I should like to pay a visit to your museum's archive.

english: Perhaps I will pay another visit to the Museum's archive.
french: Je me rendrai peut-être à nouveau aux archives du musée.
russian: Возможно, я ещё загляну в музейные архивы.
bulgarian: Perhaps I will pay another visit to the Museum's archive.

english: Someday, I should like to pay a visit to your museum's archive.
french: J'aimerais un jour me parcourir les archives de votre musée.
russian: Когда-нибудь мне бы хотелось заглянуть в музейные архивы.
bulgarian: Someday, I should like to pay a visit to your museum's archive.

english: There is much recorded in these scrolls. It has made me curious to learn more about what transpired during the years I was asleep.
french: Il y a beaucoup d'informations consignées dans ces rouleaux. Cela m'a donné envie d'en apprendre plus sur ce qu'il s'est produit pendant mes années de sommeil.
russian: В этих свитках описано многое. Читая их, я испытываю любопытство. Что же произошло за все те годы моего сна?
bulgarian: There is much recorded in these scrolls. It has made me curious to learn more about what transpired during the years I was asleep.

english: Scrolls are simply quite difficult to organize.
french: Simplement, il est très difficile de ranger des rouleaux.
russian: Просто эти свитки особенно тяжело упорядочить.
bulgarian: Scrolls are simply quite difficult to organize.

english: I assure you, I am not a messy person.
french: Je ne suis pas quelqu'un de désordonné, je t'assure.
russian: Я не испытываю проблем с порядком.
bulgarian: I assure you, I am not a messy person.

english: One day, I must make the time to read something more contemporary.
french: Un jour, il faudrait que je prenne le temps de lire des récits plus contemporains.
russian: Когда-нибудь мне следует прочитать что-нибудь более современное.
bulgarian: One day, I must make the time to read something more contemporary.

english: I spend most of my reading time pouring over the historical accounts in these scrolls.
french: Je passe l'essentiel de mon temps de lecture à parcourir les témoignages historiques contenus dans ces parchemins.
russian: Большую часть моего чтения составляют исторические сводки из этих свитков.
bulgarian: I spend most of my reading time pouring over the historical accounts in these scrolls.

english: I was hoping to see you today. Are you well?
bulgarian: I was hoping to see you today. Are you well?

english: [Ari]!
bulgarian: [Ari]!

english: I have continued to practice my cooking, if you are ever interested in another home cooked meal.
bulgarian: I have continued to practice my cooking, if you are ever interested in another home cooked meal.

english: Do you have time to, er...
bulgarian: Do you have time to, er...

english: "Hang out" I believe is the term?
bulgarian: "Hang out" I believe is the term?

english: [Ari], good morning.
bulgarian: [Ari], good morning.

english: Let us take a moment to appreciate the day, [Ari].
bulgarian: Let us take a moment to appreciate the day, [Ari].

english: Ah, [Ari]! Good afternoon.
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]! Good afternoon.

english: It is good to see you, [Ari]! How has your day been thus far?
bulgarian: It is good to see you, [Ari]! How has your day been thus far?

english: I would quite like to hear about it.
bulgarian: I would quite like to hear about it.

english: [Ari], did you have a pleasant day?
bulgarian: [Ari], did you have a pleasant day?

english: Ah, [Ari]! Another peaceful evening is ahead of us to enjoy.
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]! Another peaceful evening is ahead of us to enjoy.

english: Good evening, [Ari].
bulgarian: Good evening, [Ari].

english: I was hoping to see you today. Are you well?
bulgarian: I was hoping to see you today. Are you well?

english: [Ari]!
bulgarian: [Ari]!

english: I have continued to practice my cooking, if you are ever interested in another home cooked meal.
bulgarian: I have continued to practice my cooking, if you are ever interested in another home cooked meal.

english: I understand that you have many responsibilities on the farm...
bulgarian: I understand that you have many responsibilities on the farm...

english: So I appreciate that you would make time to visit me so early in the day.
bulgarian: So I appreciate that you would make time to visit me so early in the day.

english: [Ari], good morning.
bulgarian: [Ari], good morning.

english: Let us take a moment to appreciate the day, [Ari].
bulgarian: Let us take a moment to appreciate the day, [Ari].

english: Ah, [Ari]! Good afternoon.
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]! Good afternoon.

english: [Ari], there is something about you today that is quite... intriguing.
bulgarian: [Ari], there is something about you today that is quite... intriguing.

english: I would quite like to hear about it.
bulgarian: I would quite like to hear about it.

english: [Ari], did you have a pleasant day?
bulgarian: [Ari], did you have a pleasant day?

english: Ah, [Ari]! Another peaceful evening is ahead of us to enjoy.
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]! Another peaceful evening is ahead of us to enjoy.

english: Good evening, [Ari].
bulgarian: Good evening, [Ari].

english: Please do not catch a chill out here on my account.
french: Surtout, ne prends pas froid en restant ici à cause de moi.
russian: Не стоит рисковать простудой ради меня.
bulgarian: Please do not catch a chill out here on my account.

english: Are you warm enough, [Ari]?
french: As-tu assez chaud, [Ari] ?
russian: Тебе достаточно тепло, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Are you warm enough, [Ari]?

english: The red and orange of autumn leaves brings dragonfire to mind.
french: Le rouge et l'orange des feuilles d'automne me font penser au feu des dragons.
russian: Красные и оранжевые осенние листья напоминают мне драконье пламя.
bulgarian: The red and orange of autumn leaves brings dragonfire to mind.

english: I hope you are enjoying the spectacle as much as I am.
french: J'espère que tu apprécies ce spectacle autant que moi.
russian: Надеюсь, это зрелище доставляет тебе не меньше удовольствия, чем мне.
bulgarian: I hope you are enjoying the spectacle as much as I am.

english: The world is putting on new colors before settling down to sleep.
french: Le monde se pare de nouvelles couleurs avant de s'assoupir.
russian: Мир облачается новыми красками перед тем, как отойти ко сну.
bulgarian: The world is putting on new colors before settling down to sleep.

english: Perhaps I will make some tea.
french: Je vais peut-être préparer du thé.
russian: Возможно, стоит заварить чай.
bulgarian: Perhaps I will make some tea.

english: The cooler weather makes one desire a hot beverage.
french: Avec le temps qui fraîchit vient l'envie d'une boisson chaude.
russian: Холодная погода заставляет желать тёплого напитка.
bulgarian: The cooler weather makes one desire a hot beverage.

english: Is there anything better?
french: Qu'y a-t-il de mieux ?
russian: Существует ли что-нибудь прекраснее?
bulgarian: Is there anything better?

english: A spring breeze rustling through the trees...
french: Une brise printanière qui fait doucement frémir les arbres...
russian: Весенний ветерок, колышащий ветви деревьев...
bulgarian: A spring breeze rustling through the trees...

english: Perhaps I will start reading that monograph I have been putting off.
french: Peut-être vais-je commencer la lecture de cette monographie que je repoussais.
russian: Думаю, начну читать монографию, которую откладывал.
bulgarian: Perhaps I will start reading that monograph I have been putting off.

english: Spring is the time of new beginnings.
french: Le printemps est la saison des nouveaux débuts.
russian: Весна — это время новых начал.
bulgarian: Spring is the time of new beginnings.

english: The verdure of spring is refreshing after a long winter. I always look forward to it.
french: La verdure printanière est revigorante après un long hiver. Je l'attends toujours avec impatience.
russian: После долгой зимы весеннее озеленение — приятное изменение. Я всегда ожидаю его с нетерпением.
bulgarian: The verdure of spring is refreshing after a long winter. I always look forward to it.

english: I am always partial to the emerging warmth of spring. It was the season I was born, you see.
french: J'ai toujours un faible pour la douceur naissante du printemps. C'est à cette saison que je suis né, vois-tu.
russian: Мне всегда особенно нравилась восходящая весной теплота. Всё-таки именно в это время года был рождён я.
bulgarian: I am always partial to the emerging warmth of spring. It was the season I was born, you see.

english: Perhaps tomorrow will be milder.
french: Peut-être fera-t-il plus doux demain.
russian: Но, возможно, завтра будет свежее.
bulgarian: Perhaps tomorrow will be milder.

english: It is quite hot and humid today...
french: Quelle journée chaude et humide !
russian: Сегодня довольно жарко и влажно...
bulgarian: It is quite hot and humid today...

english: You are welcome to visit any time you need a break from the summer heat.
french: Viens me rendre visite quand tu le souhaites si tu as besoin de fuir un moment la chaleur de l'été.
russian: Ты всегда можешь укрыться здесь от летней жары.
bulgarian: You are welcome to visit any time you need a break from the summer heat.

english: It is cooler here in the forest with all this shade.
french: Il fait plus frais ici, dans la forêt, avec toute cette ombre.
russian: В этом лесу, под тенью деревьев, намного прохладнее, чем за его пределами.
bulgarian: It is cooler here in the forest with all this shade.

english: Such heat can become intense for a dragon as well.
french: Une telle chaleur peut s'avérer intense pour un dragon aussi.
russian: Даже дракона такой жар может угнетать.
bulgarian: Such heat can become intense for a dragon as well.

english: The sun's rays have become quite strong, have they not?
french: Les rayons du soleil sont devenus très forts, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Солнечный свет стал довольно сильно греть, не так ли?
bulgarian: The sun's rays have become quite strong, have they not?

english: They must all be enjoying these warm nights.
french: Tous apprécient sans doute la douceur des nuits.
russian: Всем им, должно быть, по нраву нынешние тёплые ночи.
bulgarian: They must all be enjoying these warm nights.

english: The insects become quite talkative this time of year. Almost as much as the plants.
french: Les insectes deviennent très bavards à cette période de l'année, presque autant que les plantes.
russian: В это время года насекомые разговорились почти так же сильно, как и растения.
bulgarian: The insects become quite talkative this time of year. Almost as much as the plants.

english: But now that you are here, please, warm up by the fire and make yourself at home.
french: Mais puisque tu es là, je t'en prie, réchauffe-toi près du feu et fais comme chez toi.
russian: Но раз уж ты здесь, пожалуйста, отогрейся у моего огня. Чувствуй себя как дома.
bulgarian: But now that you are here, please, warm up by the fire and make yourself at home.

english: It is cold today, [Ari]. I hope you did not force yourself to come all the way out here for my sake...
french: Il fait froid aujourd'hui, [Ari]. J'espère que tu <he>ne t'es pas forcé à</he><she>ne t'es pas forcée à</she><they>n'as pas fait l'effort de</they> faire tout ce chemin rien que pour moi...
russian: Сегодня прохладно, [Ari]. Надеюсь, тебе не пришлось заставлять себя идти сюда ради одного лишь меня...
bulgarian: It is cold today, [Ari]. I hope you did not force yourself to come all the way out here for my sake...

english: I suppose you could say I find the atmosphere comforting.
french: D'une certaine manière, je trouve cette atmosphère rassurante.
russian: Можно сказать, что я нахожу такую атмосферу угодной.
bulgarian: I suppose you could say I find the atmosphere comforting.

english: The snow makes the Deep Woods look ethereal...
french: La neige donne à Boissombre un aspect irréel...
russian: Снег придаёт Глубокой чаще очень воздушный вид...
bulgarian: The snow makes the Deep Woods look ethereal...

english: Make certain that you do not become lost while exploring it.
french: Fais bien attention à ne pas t'égarer lorsque tu l'explores.
russian: Соблюдай осторожность, чтобы не потеряться, исследуя его.
bulgarian: Make certain that you do not become lost while exploring it.

english: The Deep Woods become another world when it is covered in snow.
french: Boissombre devient un tout autre monde quand la forêt se couvre de neige.
russian: Осыпанная снегом, Глубокая чаща становится похожа на какой-то другой мир.
bulgarian: The Deep Woods become another world when it is covered in snow.

english: Is your home warm enough in the winter? You are welcome inside mine any time you would like shelter from the elements.
french: Ta maison est-elle assez chaude durant l'hiver ? Je t'accueille avec plaisir dans la mienne à tout moment si tu as besoin de t'abriter des éléments.
russian: Достаточно ли тепло в твоём жилище в зимнюю пору? Я всегда рад принять тебя в своём, если тебе понадобится убежище от холодов.
bulgarian: Is your home warm enough in the winter? You are welcome inside mine any time you would like shelter from the elements.

english: Are you warm enough [Ari]? You are welcome inside my temple any time you would like shelter from the elements.
french: As-tu assez chaud, [Ari] ? Je t'accueille avec plaisir dans mon temple à chaque fois qu'il te faut t'abriter des éléments.
russian: Тебе достаточно тепло, [Ari]? Я всегда рад принять тебя в своём храме, если тебе понадобится убежище от холодов.
bulgarian: Are you warm enough [Ari]? You are welcome inside my temple any time you would like shelter from the elements.

english: And so, it is my turn to carry on with their work.
french: C'est maintenant à mon tour de poursuivre leur tâche.
russian: Теперь настал мой черёд продолжать их работу.
bulgarian: And so, it is my turn to carry on with their work.

english: It appears that the Dragon Priestesses cleaned and polished this statue regularly, even as I slept.
french: Apparemment, les prêtresses dragon nettoyaient et faisaient briller cette statue régulièrement, même pendant mon sommeil.
russian: Похоже, даже пока я спал, жрицы дракона чистили и шлифовали эту статую.
bulgarian: It appears that the Dragon Priestesses cleaned and polished this statue regularly, even as I slept.

english: It always pleases me to drape a fresh garland on this statue.
french: Cela me fait toujours plaisir d'enrouler une guirlande fraîche autour de cette statue.
russian: Мне всегда отрадно украшать эту статую свежими венками.
bulgarian: It always pleases me to drape a fresh garland on this statue.

english: As such, I adhere to a strict cleaning schedule.
french: Par conséquent, je m'astreins à un calendrier de nettoyage rigoureux.
russian: Чтобы избежать этого впредь, я придерживаюсь строгого распорядка уборки.
bulgarian: As such, I adhere to a strict cleaning schedule.

english: When I awoke, this temple was very dusty.
french: Quand je me suis éveillé, ce temple était très poussiéreux.
russian: Когда я пробудился, этот храм был погребён под слоями пыли.
bulgarian: When I awoke, this temple was very dusty.

english: Successive generations of priestesses took turns shaping it into my likeness.
french: Tour à tour, plusieurs générations de prêtresses successives l'ont façonné pour lui donner mon image.
russian: Поколениями жрицы вытачивали из камня мой образ.
bulgarian: Successive generations of priestesses took turns shaping it into my likeness.

english: And so, it is very special to me.
french: C'est pour cela qu'elle m'est très chère.
russian: Вот почему эта статуя много для меня значит.
bulgarian: And so, it is very special to me.

english: This statue was once a dragon-shaped boulder found by a Dragon Priestess.
french: Cette statue était jadis un rocher en forme de dragon découvert par une prêtresse dragon.
russian: Когда жрицы дракона обнаружили её, эта статуя была обычным булыжников, напоминающим по форме дракона.
bulgarian: This statue was once a dragon-shaped boulder found by a Dragon Priestess.

english: I like to save them, until I have enough to make incense.
french: J'aime les conserver jusqu'à en avoir assez pour fabriquer de l'encens.
russian: Мне нравится сохранять их, чтобы при случае сделать из них благовония.
bulgarian: I like to save them, until I have enough to make incense.

english: I am pruning some of the wilted petals from this garland.
french: Je retire certains des pétales fanés de cette guirlande.
russian: Я выбираю из венка увядшие цветы.
bulgarian: I am pruning some of the wilted petals from this garland.

english: Someday, I would enjoy participating in such a get-together. It sounds like a lively event.
french: Un jour, j'aimerais participer à ce type de rassemblement. L'événement a l'air animé.
russian: Когда-нибудь я бы с удовольствием присоединился к сему собранию. Звучит, как оживлённое мероприятие.
bulgarian: Someday, I would enjoy participating in such a get-together. It sounds like a lively event.

english: Are you intending to meet with your neighbors at the Inn this eve?
french: As-tu l'intention de retrouver tes voisins à l'auberge, ce soir ?
russian: Собираешься ли ты встретиться со своими соседями в трактире этим вечером?
bulgarian: Are you intending to meet with your neighbors at the Inn this eve?

english: Though unconventional, he seems perfectly willing to take orders I have been leaving out near the stairs to town.
french: Quoique cela soit peu conventionnel, il semble tout à fait d'accord pour prendre les commandes que je lui laisse près des escaliers menant à la ville.
russian: Может быть, это и не очень обычно, но он, кажется, не против выполнять мои заказы, какие я оставляю рядом с лестницей в город.
bulgarian: Though unconventional, he seems perfectly willing to take orders I have been leaving out near the stairs to town.

english: That is good news for my dwindling pantry.
french: C'est là une bonne nouvelle pour mon garde-manger qui se vide.
russian: Моей не отличающейся разнообразием запасов кладовой это идёт на пользу.
bulgarian: That is good news for my dwindling pantry.

english: I admire that merchant, Balor. He is quite discreet, and respects discretion in kind.
french: J'admire Balor, le marchand. Il est très discret et respecte, en retour, la discrétion des autres.
russian: Мне по душе этот торговец, Балор. Он не афиширует свои дела и ценит, когда другие тоже соблюдают осторожность.
bulgarian: I admire that merchant, Balor. He is quite discreet, and respects discretion in kind.

english: I could not help but intervene with a wind spell when she nearly fell in...
french: Quand elle a failli tomber dans l'eau, je n'ai pas pu m'empêcher d'intervenir avec un sort de vent.
russian: Я не мог не вмешаться, когда она чуть не упала, и использовал заклинание ветра...
bulgarian: I could not help but intervene with a wind spell when she nearly fell in...

english: I noticed Celine foraging by the pond earlier.
french: J'ai remarqué Céline qui faisait de la cueillette près de l'étang, tout à l'heure.
russian: Чуть ранее я заметил Селин за сбором плодов рядом с прудом.
bulgarian: I noticed Celine foraging by the pond earlier.

english: She is also convinced that a headless knight, a gryphon, and a mermaid reside here too.
french: Elle est aussi convaincue qu'ils abritent aussi un chevalier sans tête, un griffon et une sirène.
russian: А ещё, что тут живут безголовый всадник, грифон и русалка.
bulgarian: She is also convinced that a headless knight, a gryphon, and a mermaid reside here too.

english: I will have to keep an eye out.
french: Je vais devoir ouvrir l'œil.
russian: Возможно, мне стоит быть начеку.
bulgarian: I will have to keep an eye out.

english: That child, Dell, is quite amusing. She is convinced a dragon lives in these woods.
french: La petite Dell est très amusante. Elle est persuadée qu'un dragon vit dans ces bois.
russian: Это дитё, Делл — она довольно занимательная. Она убеждена, что в этом лесу живёт дракон.
bulgarian: That child, Dell, is quite amusing. She is convinced a dragon lives in these woods.

english: I am curious to see his reaction when he discovers that one lives alongside him.
french: Je serais curieux de voir sa réaction quand il découvrira qu'un dragon vit à ses côtés.
russian: Будет занимательно наблюдать его реакцию, когда он узнает, что один из них живёт рядом.
bulgarian: I am curious to see his reaction when he discovers that one lives alongside him.

english: The young Lord Eiland seems to be quite invested in the history of the Dragonsworn.
french: Le jeune messire Eiland semble s'investir énormément dans l'histoire du paladin du dragon.
russian: Молодой лорд Эйланд испытывает крайний интерес к истории драконоверных.
bulgarian: The young Lord Eiland seems to be quite invested in the history of the Dragonsworn.

english: Someday I would like to explore such a collection of knowledge. I am sure I would learn much.
french: J'aimerais un jour explorer une telle collection de savoir. Je suis certain que j'apprendrais beaucoup.
russian: Я бы хотел когда-нибудь изучить её коллекцию знаний. Уверен, я узнаю много нового.
bulgarian: Someday I would like to explore such a collection of knowledge. I am sure I would learn much.

english: I have heard tell of Lady Elsie and her vast library.
french: J'ai entendu parler de dame Elsie et de son immense bibliothèque.
russian: Я слышал истории о большой библиотеке леди Элси.
bulgarian: I have heard tell of Lady Elsie and her vast library.

english: Henrietta sounds to be a proud and noble creature. I would like to meet her some day.
french: Henrietta semble être une créature noble et fière. Il me plairait de la rencontrer un jour.
russian: По описаниям, Генриетта — гордое и благородное создание. Я бы хотел когда-нибудь познакомиться с ней.
bulgarian: Henrietta sounds to be a proud and noble creature. I would like to meet her some day.

english: It seems that Juniper followed a leyline into the Deep Woods.
french: Juniper semblait suivre une ligne de force tellurique qui s'enfonçait dans Boissombre.
russian: Судя по всему, Джунипер проследовала в Глубокую чащу по следу магической жилы.
bulgarian: It seems that Juniper followed a leyline into the Deep Woods.

english: She lost track of it, so I gave her a hint before I could help myself.
french: Elle en a perdu la trace, et je n'ai pas pu m'empêcher de lui donner un indice.
russian: Но в какой-то момент она потеряла след. Я не смог ничего с собой поделать и дал ей подсказку.
bulgarian: She lost track of it, so I gave her a hint before I could help myself.

english: I was hidden, though, so I must have given her a fright. Her scream disturbed every bird in the Deep Woods.
french: Mais comme j'étais caché, j'ai dû lui faire une jolie frayeur. Son hurlement a affolé tous les oiseaux de Boissombre.
russian: Я не показался ей на глаза, и она, видимо, переволновалась. Её вопль перепугал всех птиц в лесу.
bulgarian: I was hidden, though, so I must have given her a fright. Her scream disturbed every bird in the Deep Woods.

english: Every bird, and one dragon.
french: Tous les oiseaux et un dragon.
russian: Всех птиц и одного дракона.
bulgarian: Every bird, and one dragon.

english: I had an interesting encounter the other day.
french: J'ai fait une rencontre intéressante l'autre jour.
russian: Недавно у меня случилась интересная встреча.
bulgarian: I had an interesting encounter the other day.

english: He seems quite at ease in the depths of the forest, and quite taken with the birds. He is able to feed them seed right out of his hand.
french: Il semble très à l'aise dans la forêt et donne l'impression d'aimer beaucoup les oiseaux. Il arrive à les nourrir en leur donnant des graines dans le creux de sa main.
russian: Мне показалось, что в глубине леса ему необычайно легко. Его любят птицы. Он кормит их семенами прямо с руки.
bulgarian: He seems quite at ease in the depths of the forest, and quite taken with the birds. He is able to feed them seed right out of his hand.

english: I have begun leaving him bundles of timber, so that he might have more freedom to enjoy his time among the trees.
french: J'ai commencé à lui laisser des fagots de bois, afin qu'il ait tout loisir de profiter du temps qu'il passe parmi les arbres.
russian: Я стал оставлять ему собранную древесину, чтобы у него было побольше времени насладиться прогулкой по лесу.
bulgarian: I have begun leaving him bundles of timber, so that he might have more freedom to enjoy his time among the trees.

english: That young carpenter, Ryis, recently ventured into the Deep Woods to gather fallen branches.
french: Ryis, le jeune menuisier, s'est récemment aventuré à Boissombre pour ramasser des branches sèches.
russian: Молодой плотник, Риз, недавно заходил в Глубокую чащу, чтобы набрать опавших ветвей.
bulgarian: That young carpenter, Ryis, recently ventured into the Deep Woods to gather fallen branches.

english: How do you think I would look with a different hair style?
french: À quoi ressemblerais-je, d'après toi, avec une autre coiffure ?
russian: Как думаешь, как бы я выглядел с новой причёской?
bulgarian: How do you think I would look with a different hair style?

english: I am curious about the Saturday Market's hair stylist, Vera.
french: Vera, la coiffeuse du marché du samedi, m'intrigue.
russian: Меня заинтересовала стилистка с Субботнего базара, Вера.
bulgarian: I am curious about the Saturday Market's hair stylist, Vera.

english: This springtime flight of petals... it feels magical, does it not?
french: Cet envol de pétales, au printemps... Cela paraît magique, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Весенний лёт лепестков... Волшебное зрелище, не так ли?
bulgarian: This springtime flight of petals... it feels magical, does it not?

english: I wonder if the poets of today are also moved by the sight.
french: Je me demande si les poètes d'aujourd'hui sont eux aussi émus par ce spectacle.
russian: Интересно, разделяют ли современные поэты их чувства?
bulgarian: I wonder if the poets of today are also moved by the sight.

english: The poets of old occasionally wrote of the dancing cherry blossoms.
french: Les poètes de jadis écrivaient parfois sur la danse des fleurs de cerisiers.
russian: В старинные времена поэты писали о танцующих в воздухе лепестках цветущей вишни.
bulgarian: The poets of old occasionally wrote of the dancing cherry blossoms.

english: Springtime in Mistria is captivating. I must be certain not to take such beauty for granted.
french: Le printemps est captivant, à Mistria. Je dois néanmoins veiller à ne pas prendre cette beauté pour acquise.
russian: Весенняя пора в Мистрии завораживает. Мне не стоит воспринимать такую красоту как должное.
bulgarian: Springtime in Mistria is captivating. I must be certain not to take such beauty for granted.

english: I enjoy watching the play of light through the trees on sunny days such as this.
french: J'aime contempler la lumière qui joue entre les feuilles des arbres les jours de beau temps comme aujourd'hui.

french: Et quel bonheur de la partager à tes côtés !
russian: Возможность разделить его с тобой — настоящий подарок.
bulgarian: And it is a gift to share it with you.

english: In my long life, I thought I had experienced everything there was to know of the world.
french: Au cours de ma longue vie, je pensais tout savoir et avoir tout connu.
russian: Я думал, что за свою долгую жизнь испытал всё, что мир может мне предложить.
bulgarian: In my long life, I thought I had experienced everything there was to know of the world.

english: While we lingered, I noticed [child_0] was transfixed by the little dragon at the center of the fountain.
french: Pendant que nous discutions, j'ai remarqué que le dragon au milieu de la fontaine semblait fasciner [child_0].
russian: Мы задержались, и я заметил, как [child_0] заворожённо смотрит на дракончика в фонтане.
bulgarian: While we lingered, I noticed [child_0] was transfixed by the little dragon at the center of the fountain.

english: Do you suppose she thinks it to be a miniature version of my shrine?
french: Tu crois qu'elle le prend pour une version miniature de mon autel ?
russian: Как думаешь, она считает, что это миниатюрная копия моего святилища?
bulgarian: Do you suppose she thinks it to be a miniature version of my shrine?

english: Earlier, [child_0] and I came across Eiland in the town square. He wished to discuss some recent translations I have done for him.
french: Tout à l'heure, [child_0] et moi avons rencontré Eiland, sur la place du village. Il voulait me parler des dernières traductions que j'ai faites pour lui.
russian: Недавно на городской площади [child_0] и я наткнулись на Эйланда. Он хотел обсудить переводы, которые я для него подготовил.
bulgarian: Earlier, [child_0] and I came across Eiland in the town square. He wished to discuss some recent translations I have done for him.

english: I support such a thing. It is important to create connections with one's peers, is it not?
french: Je suis pour. C'est important de tisser des liens avec les autres, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Я поддерживаю это начинание. Налаживать связи с ровесниками — благое дело.
bulgarian: I support such a thing. It is important to create connections with one's peers, is it not?

english: Though perhaps... it would do to wait until she can walk on her own.
french: En revanche... il vaudrait mieux attendre qu'elle sache marcher toute seule.
russian: Однако... Возможно, стоит прежде дождаться, пока она научится самостоятельно ходить.
bulgarian: Though perhaps... it would do to wait until she can walk on her own.

english: The children of the town seem eager to recruit [child_0] into the Dragonguard.
french: Les enfants de Mistria semblent avoir envie de recruter notre adorable [child_0] dans la Garde des dragons.
russian: Местные ребята уже хотят, чтобы [child_0] вступила в Драконью стражу.
bulgarian: The children of the town seem eager to recruit [child_0] into the Dragonguard.

english: You are a miracle carrying a miracle, [Ari].
french: Toi, qui es déjà un miracle, tu vas donner vie à un autre miracle, [Ari].
russian: [Ari], ты просто чудо. А в тебе — ещё одно чудо.
bulgarian: You are a miracle carrying a miracle, [Ari].

english: I cannot believe it. You and I... this child...
french: J'ai du mal à m'y faire. Toi, moi... et notre enfant...
russian: Мне не верится. Ты, я... и теперь ещё дитя...
bulgarian: I cannot believe it. You and I... this child...

english: I do not wish to tempt fate with my own cooking, in case your stomach is feeling delicate.
french: Je préfère ne pas tenter le diable en cuisinant moi-même, au cas où tu aurais l'estomac fragile.
russian: Я не хочу пытаться готовить сам и искушать судьбу. Твой желудок сейчас требует осторожного обращения.
bulgarian: I do not wish to tempt fate with my own cooking, in case your stomach is feeling delicate.

english: What food do you desire? I was sure to return with a variety of options.
french: Que veux-tu manger ? Je suis revenu avec plusieurs plats différents, pour que tu aies le choix.
russian: Какой еды тебе бы хотелось? Я принёс множество вариантов.
bulgarian: What food do you desire? I was sure to return with a variety of options.

english: I'm craving Grilled Cheese!
french: Le croque au fromage me fait très envie !
russian: Хочу горячий сэндвич с сыром!
bulgarian: I'm craving Grilled Cheese!

english: I'd love the Jam Sandwich!
french: J'adorerais le sandwich à la confiture !
russian: Меня так и тянет на сэндвич с джемом!
bulgarian: I'd love the Jam Sandwich!

english: Give me that Hot Chocolate right now.
french: Donne-moi ce chocolat chaud, tout de suite.
russian: Дай мне скорее горячего шоколада.
bulgarian: Give me that Hot Chocolate right now.

english: Of course. And I insisted on extra $Cheese$, just for you.
french: Bien sûr. Et j'ai demandé un supplément $fromage$ rien que pour toi.
russian: Разумеется. Для тебя я попросил побольше $сыра$.
bulgarian: Of course. And I insisted on extra $Cheese$, just for you.

english: It is still warm and toasty. Please enjoy it.
french: Il est encore chaud et croustillant. Bon appétit.
russian: Он ещё тёплый и хрустит. Пожалуйста, угощайся.
bulgarian: It is still warm and toasty. Please enjoy it.

english: Of course. I made certain they anointed both pieces of bread with jam, just how you like it.
french: Bien sûr. J'ai demandé spécialement qu'ils tartinent bien de confiture les deux côtés du pain, comme tu aimes.
russian: Разумеется. Я убедился, чтобы они промазали джемом обе половинки, как ты любишь.
bulgarian: Of course. I made certain they anointed both pieces of bread with jam, just how you like it.

english: The bread and jam are both quite fresh. Please, enjoy!
french: Le pain est tout frais et la confiture est de l'année. Bon appétit !
russian: И хлеб и джем очень свежие. Пожалуйста, угощайся!
bulgarian: The bread and jam are both quite fresh. Please, enjoy!

english: Of course. I would never come between my love and <he>his</he><she>her</she><they>their</they><it>its</it><none>[Ari]'s</none> desires.
french: Bien sûr. Je ne saurais m'interposer entre l'amour de ma vie et ses volontés.
russian:
Разумеется. Всё, что угодно

моим любимым

моей любимоймоему любимомумоему любимому.
bulgarian: Of course. I would never come between my love and <he>his</he><she>her</she><they>their</they><it>its</it><none>[Ari]'s</none> desires.

english: I blew on it as I walked home, so it should be the perfect temperature by now. Please, enjoy it!
french: J'ai soufflé dessus sur le trajet du retour, il devrait être à la température idéale. Bon appétit !
russian: Подул на него, пока шёл до дома, так что сейчас должно быть как раз нужной температуры. Пожалуйста, угощайся!
bulgarian: I blew on it as I walked home, so it should be the perfect temperature by now. Please, enjoy it!

english: [Ari], I have visited the Inn and brought back some foods you might enjoy.
french: [Ari], je suis allé à l'auberge et j'ai rapporté quelques petites choses qui, à mon avis, te plairont.
russian: [Ari], я зашёл в трактир и принёс пищу, чтобы тебя порадовать.
bulgarian: [Ari], I have visited the Inn and brought back some foods you might enjoy.

english: So I have been seeking out our neighbors to determine how best to care for you.
french: J'ai donc demandé à nos voisins comment faire pour m'occuper de toi au mieux.
russian: Поэтому я обошёл наших соседей с вопросом, как лучше о тебе заботиться.
bulgarian: So I have been seeking out our neighbors to determine how best to care for you.

english: I asked Balor for advice... who suggested I ask Hemlock, who suggested I ask Juniper, who suggested I ask Valen.
french: Je suis allé voir Balor, qui m'a dit de m'adresser à Hemlock, qui m'a redirigé vers Juniper, qui m'a envoyé chez Valen.
russian: Я спросил совета у Балора... он сказал спросить Хемлока, а он сказал спросить Джунипер, а она сказала спросить Вален.
bulgarian: I asked Balor for advice... who suggested I ask Hemlock, who suggested I ask Juniper, who suggested I ask Valen.

english: Valen kindly recommended you take this to improve your vitality, and she assured me it was safe for the baby. I do hope it helps.
french: Elle m'a gentiment conseillé ce remède qui te permettra de retrouver ton dynamisme. Elle m'a assuré que c'était sans danger pour le bébé. J'espère que ça t'aidera.
russian: Вален рекомендует тебе принимать этот сироп, чтобы дать сил организму. Она заверила меня, что это безопасно для малыша. Надеюсь, тебе правда поможет.
bulgarian: Valen kindly recommended you take this to improve your vitality, and she assured me it was safe for the baby. I do hope it helps.

english: I am aware of what you call morning sickness, and I thought you might be feeling poorly...
french: Je sais que tu as souvent des nausées le matin et que tu risquais de ne pas te sentir bien...
russian: Я знаю про так называемую «утреннюю тошноту» и заметил, что тебе, вероятно, нехорошо...
bulgarian: I am aware of what you call morning sickness, and I thought you might be feeling poorly...

english: Truly? How exciting... this means things are progressing well, does it not?
french: Vraiment ? Quelle bonne nouvelle ! C'est donc que les choses vont dans le bon sens, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Правда? Звучит замечательно... Значит, всё идёт хорошо.
bulgarian: Truly? How exciting... this means things are progressing well, does it not?

english: Please tell me if you feel any discomfort... It is my duty to fetch anything you might need.
french: Si tu éprouves la moindre douleur ou le moindre inconfort, dis-le-moi... Je me dois de me procurer tout ce qui peut t'être utile.
russian: Пожалуйста, сообщи мне, если испытываешь неудобство... Мой долг — обеспечить тебя всем необходимым.
bulgarian: Please tell me if you feel any discomfort... It is my duty to fetch anything you might need.

english: Are they? This means things are progressing well, does it not?
french: Vraiment ? C'est donc que les choses vont dans le bon sens, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Правда? Значит, всё идёт хорошо, да ведь?
bulgarian: Are they? This means things are progressing well, does it not?

english: You are free to borrow any of my robes, if you wish. They are quite roomy... though perhaps a touch long for you.
french: N'hésite pas à utiliser mes tuniques. Elles sont assez amples... mais peut-être un peu longues pour toi.
russian: Ты можешь одолжить у меня любую одежду, если пожелаешь. Она весьма свободная... хотя слегка длинновата для твоего размера.
bulgarian: You are free to borrow any of my robes, if you wish. They are quite roomy... though perhaps a touch long for you.

english: You are certain?
french: Tu en es sûr<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> ?
russian:
Ты

уверены

уверенауверенуверено?
bulgarian: You are certain?

english: Do not feel you must endure any discomfort... It is my duty to fetch anything you might need.
french: Tu ne dois pas éprouver la moindre douleur ou le moindre inconfort... Je me dois de me procurer tout ce qui peut t'être utile.
russian: Не надо пытаться перетерпеть неудобства ... Мой долг — обеспечить тебя всем необходимым.
bulgarian: Do not feel you must endure any discomfort... It is my duty to fetch anything you might need.

english: [Ari], how is your health today? Are you well?
french: [Ari], comme te sens-tu, aujourd'hui ? Tout va bien ?
russian: [Ari], как твоё здоровье? Хорошо себя чувствуешь?
bulgarian: [Ari], how is your health today? Are you well?

english: It feels like the baby is getting bigger!
french: J'ai l'impression que le bébé grossit.
russian: Кажется, малыш растёт!
bulgarian: It feels like the baby is getting bigger!

english: It feels like my clothes are getting tighter!
french: J'ai l'impression que mes vêtements rétrécissent.
russian: Одежда как будто стала теснее!
bulgarian: It feels like my clothes are getting tighter!

english: I feel fine!
french: Je me sens bien !
russian: Отлично!
bulgarian: I feel fine!

english: May I touch your stomach?
french: Puis-je toucher ton ventre ?
russian: Могу я потрогать твой живот?
bulgarian: May I touch your stomach?

english: Yes, I feel it. Incredible...
french: Oui, je le sens. C'est incroyable...
russian: Да, я чувствую. Невероятно...
bulgarian: Yes, I feel it. Incredible...

english: Hello, little one. I am excited to meet you.
french: Bonjour, petit être. J'ai hâte de te rencontrer.
russian: Здравствуй, малютка. Жду, когда мы встретимся.
bulgarian: Hello, little one. I am excited to meet you.

english: What is the matter? Ah, the baby is moving?
french: Quel est le problème ? Ah, le bébé a bougé ?
russian: В чём дело? О, неужели малыш двигается?
bulgarian: What is the matter? Ah, the baby is moving?

english: Of course, it is not for me to decide alone.
french: Bien sûr, ce n'est pas à moi d'en décider seul.
russian: Разумеется, это решение принимаю не я один.
bulgarian: Of course, it is not for me to decide alone.

english: But if they are a girl, $Tephra$ is a draconic name that I have always had a fondness for.
french: Mais si c'est une fille, $Tephra$ est un prénom draconique que j'ai toujours aimé.
russian: Но есть одно драконье имя, которое мне всегда нравилось, — $Тефра$. Подойдёт, если будет девочка.
bulgarian: But if they are a girl, $Tephra$ is a draconic name that I have always had a fondness for.

english: [Ari]... I have been considering names our child might be given.
french: [Ari]... J'ai réfléchi à des noms que l'on pourrait donner à notre bébé.
russian: [Ari]... Я размышлял над именем, которое получит наш ребёнок.
bulgarian: [Ari]... I have been considering names our child might be given.

english: Do not fret, beloved. Whatever the future holds, we will take it on together.
french: Ne t'en fais pas, mon amour. Qu'importe ce que l'avenir nous réserve, nous l'affronterons ensemble.
russian:
Не тревожься,

любимые

любимаялюбимыйлюбимое. Что бы ни готовило нам будущее, мы примем его вместе.
bulgarian: Do not fret, beloved. Whatever the future holds, we will take it on together.

english: All three of us!
french: Nous trois !
russian: Втроём!
bulgarian: All three of us!

english: Intuition tells me that the baby's arrival is near.
french: Mon intuition me dit que l'arrivée du bébé est imminente.
russian: Интуиция подсказывает мне, что ребёнок скоро появится.
bulgarian: Intuition tells me that the baby's arrival is near.

english: I wonder if they'll have little dragon horns? That would be sooo cute!
french: Je me demande s'il aura des petites cornes de dragon. Ça serait trop mignon !
russian: Интересно, у него будут драконьи рожки? Было бы та-а-ак мило!
bulgarian: I wonder if they'll have little dragon horns? That would be sooo cute!

english: The whole town's buzzing with the news! I can't believe you and Caldarus are having a baby!
french: Toute la ville est en effervescence depuis que nous avons appris la nouvelle ! Je n'arrive pas à croire que Caldarus et toi attendez un bébé !
russian: Поверить не могу: у вас с Кальдарусом будет малыш! На каждом углу только об этом и жужжат!
bulgarian: The whole town's buzzing with the news! I can't believe you and Caldarus are having a baby!

english: This is extraordinary! Unprecedented! Historic!
french: C'est extraordinaire ! Sans précédent ! Historique, même !
russian: Это же экстраординарное событие! Беспрецендентое! Историческое!
bulgarian: This is extraordinary! Unprecedented! Historic!

english: Do not hesitate to ask if I can do anything for you two! I am at your service!
french: Si je peux faire quoi que ce soit pour vous deux, n'hésite pas ! Je suis à votre disposition !
russian: Если я могу вам чем-то помочь, спрашивай, не стесняйся. Я к вашим услугам!
bulgarian: Do not hesitate to ask if I can do anything for you two! I am at your service!

english: [Ari]! I've heard the news! You and Caldarus? A dragon baby?
french: [Ari] ! Je suis au courant de la nouvelle ! Caldarus et toi attendez un bébé dragon ?
russian: [Ari]! Я уже всё слышал! Малыш-дракончик? У вас с Кальдарусом?
bulgarian: [Ari]! I've heard the news! You and Caldarus? A dragon baby?

english: Wow... maybe some day they'll be able to join the Dragonguard...
french: Ouah... Peut-être qu'un jour, votre enfant pourra intégrer la Garde des dragons...
russian: Ого... Может, когда-нибудь он сможет вступить в Драконью стражу...
bulgarian: Wow... maybe some day they'll be able to join the Dragonguard...

english: Imagine! A member of the Dragonguard that's a real dragon!
french: Imagine un peu ! Un vrai dragon dans la Garde des dragons !
russian: Представляешь? Настоящий дракон в рядах Драконьей стражи!
bulgarian: Imagine! A member of the Dragonguard that's a real dragon!

english: [Ari]! Is it true that you and Caldarus are having a baby together?
french: [Ari] ! C'est vrai que Caldarus et toi allez avoir un bébé ?
russian: [Ari]! Это правда, что у вас с Кальдарусом будет ребёнок?
bulgarian: [Ari]! Is it true that you and Caldarus are having a baby together?

english: That's great news! Kids are the best.
french: C'est une super nouvelle ! Les enfants, c'est génial.
russian: Прекрасная новость! Дети — это замечательно.
bulgarian: That's great news! Kids are the best.

english: Hey! I heard you and Caldarus are having a kid?
french: Hé ! Il paraît que Caldarus et toi allez avoir un bébé ?
russian: Привет! Слышал, вы с Кальдарусом решили завести ребёнка?
bulgarian: Hey! I heard you and Caldarus are having a kid?

english: Still, the birth of a dragon is an auspicious blessing. Despite your child's parentage, it is good to see our kind flourishing.
french: Néanmoins, la naissance d'un bébé dragon est de bon augure. Malgré le lignage de ton enfant, voir notre espèce prospérer est une bonne chose.
russian: И всё же рождение дракона — благое свершение. Если закрыть глаза на происхождение твоего ребёнка, приятно, что наш род процветает.
bulgarian: Still, the birth of a dragon is an auspicious blessing. Despite your child's parentage, it is good to see our kind flourishing.

english: Do tell me if you need advice on raising a youngling. Dragon children can be... precocious.
french: Si tu as besoin de conseils pour élever l'enfant, dis-le-moi. Les bébés dragons peuvent se montrer... précoces.
russian: Обязательно приходи, если нужен будет совет по уходу за молодняком. Драконьи дети иногда... растут не по годам.
bulgarian: Do tell me if you need advice on raising a youngling. Dragon children can be... precocious.

english: It is preposterous that one such as Caldarus desired to procreate. As long as I have known him, he never showed interest in babies.
french: Je trouve grotesque que quelqu'un comme Caldarus ait eu le désir de procréer. Depuis que je le connais, les enfants n'ont jamais suscité le moindre intérêt chez lui.
russian: Со стороны Кальдаруса совершенно нелепо проявлять стремление к деторождению. Сколько я его знаю, он никогда не выказывал интереса к детям.
bulgarian: It is preposterous that one such as Caldarus desired to procreate. As long as I have known him, he never showed interest in babies.

english: This is a miracle, [Ari].
french: C'est un miracle, [Ari].
russian: Это настоящее чудо, [Ari].
bulgarian: This is a miracle, [Ari].

english: I cannot believe it. You and I... a child...
french: Je n'arrive pas à y croire... Toi et moi... Un bébé...
russian: Мне не верится. Ты, я... дитя...
bulgarian: I cannot believe it. You and I... a child...

english: I do not believe all of them are to be taken seriously... But do know I have scoured every one that exists in town, and every scroll in the Deep Woods temple.
french: Je ne pense pas qu'ils soient tous très utiles... mais sache que j'ai parcouru tous ceux que l'on trouve en ville, ainsi que tous les parchemins du temple de Boissombre.
russian: Я не думаю, что их все следует принимать на веру... Но могу точно сказать, что я перерыл все книги в городе. И все свитки в храме в Глубокой чаще.
bulgarian: I do not believe all of them are to be taken seriously... But do know I have scoured every one that exists in town, and every scroll in the Deep Woods temple.

english: Including the ones about the care of baby animals, in case they might offer insight.
french: Et même ceux sur la façon de s'occuper de bébés animaux, au cas où ils contiendraient des informations intéressantes.
