russian: В том числе по заботе о маленьких животных. Вдруг там найдутся полезные сведения.
bulgarian: Including the ones about the care of baby animals, in case they might offer insight.

english: It is astonishing, the number of books that have been written about child-rearing.
french: C'est incroyable le nombre de livres écrits sur l'éducation des enfants.
russian: О воспитании детей написано поистине умопомрачительное множество книг.
bulgarian: It is astonishing, the number of books that have been written about child-rearing.

english: In my long life, I have never raised a child. It was something I never considered... or perhaps I never had a mate I wished to have a child with.
french: Au cours de ma longue vie, je n'ai jamais élevé d'enfant. Ça ne m'a pas traversé l'esprit... ou peut-être que je n'avais pas trouvé de partenaire m'ayant donné l'envie de procréer.
russian: За свою долгую жизнь я ни разу не воспитывал ребёнка. Я даже никогда об этом не задумывался... Или, быть может, не имел партнёра, с которым захотелось бы заводить детей.
bulgarian: In my long life, I have never raised a child. It was something I never considered... or perhaps I never had a mate I wished to have a child with.

english: I have knowledge of many things. But I fear I have never nurtured a life.
french: Mon savoir est très vaste, mais jamais je n'ai élevé un enfant, je le crains.
russian: Мои познания в мире обширны. Однако, боюсь, я ещё не взращивал новую жизнь.
bulgarian: I have knowledge of many things. But I fear I have never nurtured a life.

english: You're going to be an incredible parent.
french: Tu feras un père incroyable.
russian: Ты будешь просто потрясающим отцом.
bulgarian: You're going to be an incredible parent.

english: Oh, Caldarus. We'll figure it out together.
french: Oh, Caldarus. Ensemble, nous y arriverons.
russian: Ох, Кальдарус. Будем разбираться вместе.
bulgarian: Oh, Caldarus. We'll figure it out together.

english: We have a village of people to help us!
french: Tous les habitants de Mistria sont disposés à nous aider !
russian: У нас целая деревня помощников!
bulgarian: We have a village of people to help us!

english: It is true that all creatures have some instinct for bringing their young into the world.
french: Il est vrai que toutes les créatures savent d'instinct comment élever un enfant.
russian: В самом деле, каждое живое создание обладает инстинктом по уходу за своим потомством.
bulgarian: It is true that all creatures have some instinct for bringing their young into the world.

english: And every parent is a first-time parent once. It would be egotistical to think that I am any different.
french: Et qu'on ne nait pas parent, on le devient. Il serait égoïste de ma part de croire que je suis différent.
russian: И каждый родитель когда-то стал родителем впервые. Полагать, что мой случай особенный, было бы эгоистично.
bulgarian: And every parent is a first-time parent once. It would be egotistical to think that I am any different.

english: Thank you. Let us learn together.
french: Merci. Nous apprendrons ensemble.
russian: Спасибо. Давай учиться вместе.
bulgarian: Thank you. Let us learn together.

english: You are right... this child is a responsibility and joy we will share.
french: Tu as raison... Notre enfant sera une responsabilité et un bonheur que nous partagerons.
russian:
Ты

правы

праваправправо... Этот ребёнок для нас — общая радость и общая ответственность.
bulgarian: You are right... this child is a responsibility and joy we will share.

english: Please, rely on me, as I rely on you. Let us learn together.
french: Sache que tu peux compter sur moi, comme je sais pouvoir compter sur toi. Nous apprendrons ensemble.
russian: Прошу, полагайся на меня так же, как я полагаюсь на тебя. Давай учиться вместе.
bulgarian: Please, rely on me, as I rely on you. Let us learn together.

english: This is true, you and I are not an island. We are surrounded by caring and dependable hands.
french: C'est vrai, nous ne vivons pas coupés du monde. Nous sommes entourés de personnes attentionnées sur lesquelles nous pouvons compter.
russian: Это правда, мы с тобой не на острове. Нас окружают заботливые и надёжные соседи.
bulgarian: This is true, you and I are not an island. We are surrounded by caring and dependable hands.

english: Let us learn by their shining example!
french: Apprenons en nous inspirant de ce qu'ils ont fait !
russian: Начнём же учиться, пользуясь их блестящим примером!
bulgarian: Let us learn by their shining example!

english: Feeding, changing, sleep cycles... baby logistics are quite involved, it seems. She went above and beyond to teach me.
french: L'alimentation, les couches, le sommeil... L'organisation que demande un bébé semble assez complexe. Elle m'a tout expliqué de A à Z.
russian: Как кормить, менять пелёнки, следить за сном... Оказывается, у малышей весьма непростая логистика. Нора приложила все усилия, чтобы обучить меня.
bulgarian: Feeding, changing, sleep cycles... baby logistics are quite involved, it seems. She went above and beyond to teach me.

english: It is heartening to know that this sense of community yet exists in Mistria, even after all these ages.
french: Il est très réconfortant de constater que ce sens de la communauté perdure à Mistria, même après de nombreux siècles.
russian: Прошло много веков, но в Мистрии до сих пор жива взаимовыручка. Это воодушевляет.
bulgarian: It is heartening to know that this sense of community yet exists in Mistria, even after all these ages.

english: I have received a tome's worth of parenting advice from Nora...
french: Nora m'a donné de très nombreux conseils sur la façon de s'occuper d'un enfant...
russian: Нора надавала мне советов по родительству на целую книгу...
bulgarian: I have received a tome's worth of parenting advice from Nora...

english: I am unbearably eager to meet our child. My mind overflows with the possibilities of who they will become.
french: Je suis si impatient de faire la connaissance de notre enfant. Je ne sais pas la voie qu'il ou elle choisira, mais l'éventail des possibilités me fait tourner la tête.
russian: Мне так не терпится увидеть нашего ребёнка. Голова полна мыслей: кем он станет в будущем?
bulgarian: I am unbearably eager to meet our child. My mind overflows with the possibilities of who they will become.

english: While I am certain they will take certain superficial attributes from me... I dearly hope they take after you in the ways that matter most.
french: Même si je sais que je lui transmettrai certains traits purement physiques, j'espère sincèrement que tout ce qui compte vraiment viendra de toi.
russian: Я убеждён, что определённые черты внешности ребёнок унаследует от меня... Однако я искренне надеюсь, что самые важные вещи он переймёт от тебя.
bulgarian: While I am certain they will take certain superficial attributes from me... I dearly hope they take after you in the ways that matter most.

english: Though I have scant experience with babies, let alone the offspring of a dragon and a mortal...
french: J'ai très peu d'expérience avec les bébés, et encore moins en ce qui concerne la progéniture d'un dragon et d'un être mortel...
russian: Мой опыт с малышами весьма скуден, тем более с потомками дракона и смертного. И всё же...
bulgarian: Though I have scant experience with babies, let alone the offspring of a dragon and a mortal...

english: Of course, it is not for me to decide alone.
french: Bien sûr, ce n'est pas à moi d'en décider seul.
russian: Разумеется, это решение принимаю не я один.
bulgarian: Of course, it is not for me to decide alone.

english: But if they are a girl, $Tephra$ is a draconic name that I have always had a fondness for.
french: Mais si c'est une fille, $Tephra$ est un prénom draconique que j'ai toujours aimé.
russian: Но есть одно драконье имя, которое мне всегда нравилось, — $Тефра$. Подойдёт, если будет девочка.
bulgarian: But if they are a girl, $Tephra$ is a draconic name that I have always had a fondness for.

english: [Ari]... I have been considering names our child might be given.
french: [Ari]... J'ai réfléchi à des noms que l'on pourrait donner à notre bébé.
russian: [Ari]... Я размышлял над именем, которое получит наш ребёнок.
bulgarian: [Ari]... I have been considering names our child might be given.

english: Do not fret, beloved. Whatever the future holds, we will take it on together.
french: Ne t'en fais pas, mon amour. Qu'importe ce que l'avenir nous réserve, nous l'affronterons ensemble.
russian:
Не тревожься,

любимые

любимаялюбимыйлюбимое. Что бы ни готовило нам будущее, мы примем его вместе.
bulgarian: Do not fret, beloved. Whatever the future holds, we will take it on together.

english: All three of us!
french: Tous les trois !
russian: Втроём!
bulgarian: All three of us!

english: Intuition tells me that the baby's arrival is near.
french: Mon intuition me dit que l'arrivée du bébé est imminente.
russian: Интуиция подсказывает мне, что ребёнок скоро появится.
bulgarian: Intuition tells me that the baby's arrival is near.

english: Indulge me... tell me of your plans for the day.
french: Allez, dis-moi ce que tu as prévu aujourd'hui.
russian: Поведай... Каковы твои планы на этот день?
bulgarian: Indulge me... tell me of your plans for the day.

english: I'll probably work on the farm today!
french: Je vais sûrement travailler à la ferme !
russian: Наверное, поработаю сегодня на ферме!
bulgarian: I'll probably work on the farm today!

english: I might head into the Mines.
french: Je vais peut-être aller dans les mines.
russian: Возможно, пойду в шахты...
bulgarian: I might head into the Mines.

english: Looks like a nice day for fishing.
french: Ça semble être une bonne journée pour pêcher.
russian: По-моему, отличный день для рыбалки.
bulgarian: Looks like a nice day for fishing.

english: It will be nice, having you close to home.
french: Je suis content que tu ne t'éloignes pas de la maison.
russian: Это хорошо. Приятно, когда ты рядом с домом.
bulgarian: It will be nice, having you close to home.

english: I will try not to interrupt your day, but please... feel free to interrupt mine.
french: Je tâcherai de ne pas te déranger, mais n'hésite pas à passer me voir.
russian: Я постараюсь не отрывать тебя от работы, а меня... пожалуйста, отрывай, сколько хочешь.
bulgarian: I will try not to interrupt your day, but please... feel free to interrupt mine.

english: The Mines... I know you are quite familiar with them at this point, but...
french: Les mines... Je sais que tu les connais bien, maintenant, mais...
russian:
В шахты... Я знаю, что сейчас ты уже хорошо там

освоились

освоиласьосвоилсяосвоилось, и всё равно...
bulgarian: The Mines... I know you are quite familiar with them at this point, but...

english: Well, one cannot help but worry for their beloved.
french: Eh bien, il est difficile de ne pas s'en faire pour la personne qu'on aime.
russian: Нельзя же не переживать за тех, кого любишь.
bulgarian: Well, one cannot help but worry for their beloved.

english: Return to me safely, [Ari].
french: Reviens-moi indemne, [Ari].
russian: Возвращайся в целости, [Ari].
bulgarian: Return to me safely, [Ari].

english: You are very skilled, to catch so many fish with only the aid of rod and string.
french: Pouvoir attraper autant de poissons avec une canne et un fil, cela prouve que tu as beaucoup de talent.
russian: Наловить так много рыбы с помощью палки и лески — настоящее мастерство.
bulgarian: You are very skilled, to catch so many fish with only the aid of rod and string.

english: I found fishing much easier with the long, toothy maw of a dragon...
french: J'ai toujours trouvé que c'était beaucoup plus facile de prendre des poissons avec une gueule et des crocs...
russian: Мне показалось гораздо проще ловить рыбу длинной зубастой пастью дракона...
bulgarian: I found fishing much easier with the long, toothy maw of a dragon...

english: Oh, I digress. I look forward to seeing your catch, [Ari].
french: Mais je m'égare. J'ai hâte de voir tes prises, [Ari].
russian: Но это я о своём. Жду тебя с уловом, [Ari].
bulgarian: Oh, I digress. I look forward to seeing your catch, [Ari].

english: Good morning, [Ari].
french: Bonjour, [Ari].
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari].
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari].

english: And I look forward to seeing you at home.
french: Et j'ai hâte de te retrouver chez nous.
russian: Буду рад видеть тебя дома.
bulgarian: And I look forward to seeing you at home.

english: I hope you are having a nice day, and accomplishing everything your heart was set upon.
french: J'espère que ta journée se déroule bien et que tu atteins les objectifs que tu t'étais fixés.
russian: Надеюсь, ты хорошо проводишь день и достигаешь всего, к чему стремишься.
bulgarian: I hope you are having a nice day, and accomplishing everything your heart was set upon.

english: I can easily divert my path on the walk home tonight.
french: Si c'est le cas, je peux tout à fait y passer en rentrant ce soir à la maison.
russian: Мне не составит труда завернуть туда по пути домой.
bulgarian: I can easily divert my path on the walk home tonight.

english: Can you recall, is there anything we require from the General Store?
french: Te souviens-tu si nous avons besoin de quelque chose du magasin général ?
russian: Можешь вспомнить, не нужно ли нам что-нибудь в универмаге?
bulgarian: Can you recall, is there anything we require from the General Store?

english: I cannot guarantee it will be well made, but...
french: Je ne peux pas garantir que ce sera bon, mais...
russian: Не могу обещать, что он будет кулинарно хорош...
bulgarian: I cannot guarantee it will be well made, but...

english: Well, I can promise it will be thoroughly-cooked.
french: Je te promets que ce sera assez cuit.
russian: Зато точно хорошо проварен.
bulgarian: Well, I can promise it will be thoroughly-cooked.

english: Allow me to prepare dinner tonight, [Ari].
french: Laisse-moi préparer le dîner de ce soir, [Ari].
russian: Позволь мне сегодня приготовить ужин, [Ari].
bulgarian: Allow me to prepare dinner tonight, [Ari].

english: I have learned much of the domestic realm of laundry, as I am particular about caring for the textiles I wear.
french: J'ai beaucoup appris dans ce domaine, car je prends particulièrement soin des textiles que je porte.
russian: Я весьма искушён в области домашней стирки, ведь я тщательно подхожу к уходу за своими одеяниями.
bulgarian: I have learned much of the domestic realm of laundry, as I am particular about caring for the textiles I wear.

english: Allow me to wash our clothes, [Ari].
french: Laisse-moi laver tes vêtements, [Ari].
russian: Позволь мне постирать нашу одежду, [Ari].
bulgarian: Allow me to wash our clothes, [Ari].

english: Here, I will even lean down for you.
french: Là, je me penche pour te faciliter la tâche.
russian: Давай я наклонюсь к тебе.
bulgarian: Here, I will even lean down for you.

english: Surely you would not walk away without giving me a kiss?
french: Tu ne t'en irais quand même pas sans m'embrasser, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Ты же не оставишь меня без поцелуя на прощание?
bulgarian: Surely you would not walk away without giving me a kiss?

english: With you... I am truly the happiest I have ever been.
french: Avec toi, je suis véritablement plus heureux que je ne l'aie jamais été.
russian: Рядом с тобой... Я счастливее, чем когда-либо прежде.
bulgarian: With you... I am truly the happiest I have ever been.

english: When I say you are the most special person in the world to me, know that the sentiment extends across a thousand years and more.
french: Quand je dis que tu es la personne la plus spéciale au monde à mes yeux, sache que je ressens à l'aune de mes milliers d'années.
russian: Когда я говорю, что ты для меня самый важный человек, знай: это сравнение охватывает более тысячи лет.
bulgarian: When I say you are the most special person in the world to me, know that the sentiment extends across a thousand years and more.

english: And you often arrive just as I am thinking of you.
french: Et tu arrives souvent lorsque je pense à toi.
russian: И часто приходишь, как раз когда я думаю о тебе.
bulgarian: And you often arrive just as I am thinking of you.

english: I have noticed you go out of your way to see me, [Ari], even when you are busy.
french: J'ai remarqué que tu faisais toujours ton possible pour passer me voir, [Ari], même quand tu as beaucoup à faire.
russian:
Я заметил, [Ari], что ты заходишь меня проведать, даже когда

заняты

занятазанятзанято.
bulgarian: I have noticed you go out of your way to see me, [Ari], even when you are busy.

english: But certainly there is no harm in giving them extra treats. Especially not to one who works so diligently.
french: Mais on peut lui donner un petit quelque chose en plus. Surtout que son travail est toujours irréprochable.
russian: Хотя, безусловно, угощение не помешает. Особенно за такую усердную работу.
bulgarian: But certainly there is no harm in giving them extra treats. Especially not to one who works so diligently.

english: Do not fret, I have already provided [pet_name] their daily food and drink...
french: Ne t'en fais pas, j'ai déjà donné à boire et à manger à [pet_name]...
russian: Не волнуйся, [pet_name] имеет достаточно пропитания на этот день... Я об этом позаботился.
bulgarian: Do not fret, I have already provided [pet_name] their daily food and drink...

english: [pet_name] is especially skilled at this.
french: Et [pet_name] sait très bien le faire.
russian: [pet_name] — отличное тому подтверждение.
bulgarian: [pet_name] is especially skilled at this.

english: I am of the opinion that there are few things more charming than a small creature curled up to sleep...
french: Je trouve qu'il n'y a rien de plus charmant qu'une petite créature recroquevillée en train de dormir...
russian: Я убеждён, что немногое в мире выглядит столь очаровательно, как маленькое создание, свернувшееся во сне...
bulgarian: I am of the opinion that there are few things more charming than a small creature curled up to sleep...

english: If you wish to share a bed, perhaps we could acquire a larger one?
french: Si tu veux que nous dormions ensemble, nous devrions peut-être en acheter un plus grand ?
russian: Если ты желаешь разделить со мной ложе, возможно, нам следует приобрести постель побольше.
bulgarian: If you wish to share a bed, perhaps we could acquire a larger one?

english: I apologize [Ari]... I do not believe our current sleeping arrangements can accommodate my height, not to mention my tail....
french: Je suis désolé, [Ari], mais je crois que l'aménagement actuel de la chambre n'est pas adapté à ma taille et encore moins à mes cornes...
russian: Прошу прощения, [Ari]... По моему разумению, наше нынешнее положение в постели не учитывает мой рост, не говоря уже о хвосте...
bulgarian: I apologize [Ari]... I do not believe our current sleeping arrangements can accommodate my height, not to mention my tail....

english: When you are away, I am comforted by these signs of your presence all around me.
french: Quand tu n'es pas là, tous ces signes de ta présence autour de moi me réconfortent beaucoup.
russian: Когда ты отлучаешься, эти напоминания о тебе меня успокаивают.
bulgarian: When you are away, I am comforted by these signs of your presence all around me.

english: Every corner of this farmstead is imbued with your spirit. You have even given my old shrine a personal touch.
french: On ressent ta patte jusque dans les moindres recoins de ta ferme. Et tu as même su donner à mon autel ta touche personnelle.
russian: Каждый уголок этой фермы наполнен тобой. Даже моё святилище несёт твой отпечаток.
bulgarian: Every corner of this farmstead is imbued with your spirit. You have even given my old shrine a personal touch.

english: I cannot express my joy at living alongside you at [farm_name]...
french: Tu n'imagines pas combien je suis heureux de vivre à tes côtés, ici à la ferme [farm_name]...
russian: «[farm_name]» — замечательное место, и я безмерно рад жить здесь вместе с тобой...
bulgarian: I cannot express my joy at living alongside you at [farm_name]...

english: However, it would please me if I had a personal study not unlike my abode in the Deep Woods. Do you believe such a thing is possible?
french: Toutefois, j'aimerais bien disposer d'un petit bureau personnel, comme ce que j'ai chez moi, à Boissombre. Crois-tu que ce serait possible ?
russian: Однако мне было бы приятно иметь собственный кабинет, подобно моему жилищу в Глубокой чаще. Как ты думаешь, это возможно устроить?
bulgarian: However, it would please me if I had a personal study not unlike my abode in the Deep Woods. Do you believe such a thing is possible?

english: [Ari], if I could make a request?
french: [Ari], puis-je formuler une demande ?
russian: [Ari], могу я высказать пожелание?
bulgarian: [Ari], if I could make a request?

english: If you would like it...
french: Si tu le souhaites...
russian: Если захочешь...
bulgarian: If you would like it...

english: I could visit you in dreams again, as I did when we first met.
french: Je peux te rendre à nouveau visite dans tes rêves, comme je l'ai fait lors de notre première rencontre.
russian: Я могу снова навещать твои сны, как когда мы только познакомились.
bulgarian: I could visit you in dreams again, as I did when we first met.

english: Good morning! Did you dream last night?
french: Bien le bonjour ! As-tu rêvé, cette nuit ?
russian: Доброе утро! Тебе что-нибудь снилось ночью?
bulgarian: Good morning! Did you dream last night?

english: The nights as well.
french: Et ces nuits.
russian: И ночью тоже.
bulgarian: The nights as well.

english: Especially the nights.
french: Spécialement les nuits.
russian: Особенно ночью.
bulgarian: Especially the nights.

english: I am so happy to have these evenings with you.
french: Je suis si heureux de passer ces soirées avec toi.
russian: Мне так нравится вечером быть рядом с тобой.
bulgarian: I am so happy to have these evenings with you.

english: I hope you will help me keep warm tonight, [Ari].
french: J'espère que tu me tiendras chaud ce soir, [Ari].
russian: Надеюсь, сегодня ты меня обогреешь, [Ari].
bulgarian: I hope you will help me keep warm tonight, [Ari].

english: It grows cooler as evening turns to night...
french: Il commence à faire froid en fin de soirée, quand la nuit tombe...
russian: Вечер сменяется ночью, и на землю спускается прохлада...
bulgarian: It grows cooler as evening turns to night...

english: I thought of you often... so mine was quite nice.
french: La mienne l'a été... car j'ai souvent pensé à toi.
russian: У меня очень хорошо... ведь я думал о тебе.
bulgarian: I thought of you often... so mine was quite nice.

english: I hope you had a good day today, [Ari].
french: J'espère que tu as passé une bonne journée, [Ari].
russian: Надеюсь, твой день прошёл хорошо, [Ari].
bulgarian: I hope you had a good day today, [Ari].

english: Allow me to make you an offering in return... with a kiss.
french: Permets-moi de t'offrir quelque chose en retour... ce baiser.
russian: Позволь мне отплатить тебе в ответ... поцелуем.
bulgarian: Allow me to make you an offering in return... with a kiss.

english: You always show me such care. Offering essence, gifts, conversation...
french: Tu me témoignes toujours beaucoup d'attention. Tu m'offres de l'essence, des cadeaux, tu discutes avec moi...
russian: Ты всегда относишься ко мне с такой заботой. Даришь мне эссенцию, подарки и свою компанию...
bulgarian: You always show me such care. Offering essence, gifts, conversation...

english: If only there were more daylight, so one might appreciate the season more fully.
french: Si seulement cette saison bénéficiait de davantage de lumière du jour, nous l'apprécierions mieux.
russian: Ах, если бы света было побольше, чтобы вдоволь насладиться этим прекрасным сезоном.
bulgarian: If only there were more daylight, so one might appreciate the season more fully.

english: Autumn days are so short.
french: Les journées sont si courtes, à l'automne.
russian: Осенние дни так коротки.
bulgarian: Autumn days are so short.

english: Once lush green, now a beautiful fiery orange like dragon fire.
french: Elle était autrefois d'un vert éclatant, mais elle a viré à ce magnifique orange vif comme les flammes d'un dragon.
russian: Когда-то он был ярко-зелёный, а теперь огненно-рыжий, словно пламя дракона.
bulgarian: Once lush green, now a beautiful fiery orange like dragon fire.

english: Truly, autumn is a season of transformation.
french: L'automne est vraiment la saison des métamorphoses.
russian: Воистину, осень — пора перемен.
bulgarian: Truly, autumn is a season of transformation.

english: I have spent the evening contemplating a leaf I found in the Deep Woods.
french: J'ai passé la soirée à observer une feuille que j'ai ramassée à Boissombre.
russian: Я провёл вечер, созерцая лист, который подобрал в Глубокой чаще.
bulgarian: I have spent the evening contemplating a leaf I found in the Deep Woods.

english: But I am reminded that winter is around the corner, and the cold will arrive soon.
french: Mais cela me fait penser que l'hiver ne tardera pas et que le froid sera bientôt là.
russian: Но природа напоминает, что зима не за горами и скоро наступят холода.
bulgarian: But I am reminded that winter is around the corner, and the cold will arrive soon.

english: I hope for a long fall, and a short winter.
french: J'espère que l'automne sera long et que l'hiver sera court.
russian: Надеюсь, осень протянется подольше, а зима будет короткой.
bulgarian: I hope for a long fall, and a short winter.

english: Autumn is a beautiful season to look upon...
french: L'automne est véritablement une saison propice à la contemplation...
russian: Осень — необычайно красивое время года...
bulgarian: Autumn is a beautiful season to look upon...

english: They are brisk... just enough to warrant another layer.
french: Leur fraîcheur vivifiante justifie tout juste de porter une couche supplémentaire.
russian: На улице прохладно... Ровно настолько, чтобы надеть ещё слой одежды.
bulgarian: They are brisk... just enough to warrant another layer.

english: I do love layering.
french: Et j'aime porter différentes couches de vêtements.
russian: А я люблю одеваться слоями.
bulgarian: I do love layering.

english: I am enjoying these autumn mornings, [Ari].
french: J'apprécie ces matinées d'automne, [Ari].
russian: Люблю гулять осенью по утрам, [Ari].
bulgarian: I am enjoying these autumn mornings, [Ari].

english: Mine has certainly been nice. Seeing your face upon waking...
french: Mon réveil a été très agréable. Voir ton visage dès que j'ouvre l'œil...
russian: У меня точно доброе. Проснулся — и увидел твоё лицо...
bulgarian: Mine has certainly been nice. Seeing your face upon waking...

english: I will never tire of it.
french: Je ne m'en lasserai jamais.
russian: Этот вид мне никогда не надоест.
bulgarian: I will never tire of it.

english: Good morning, [Ari].
french: Bonjour, [Ari].
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari].
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari].

english: And a good day to accomplish many things.
french: La journée s'annonce parfaite pour accomplir tant de choses.
russian: И хороший день, чтобы заняться делами.
bulgarian: And a good day to accomplish many things.

english: It is a good morning, [Ari].
french: Quelle belle matinée, [Ari].
russian: Хорошее сегодня утро, [Ari].
bulgarian: It is a good morning, [Ari].

english: But both sound like home.
french: Tu devrais peut-être plutôt rester à la maison et me tenir compagnie.
russian: Может, лучше составишь мне компанию дома?
bulgarian: But both sound like home.

english: The rain on the roof of our house sounds different from rain on the Deep Woods canopy...
french: As-tu vraiment envie de sortir affronter les intempéries ?
russian:
Ты

уверены

уверенауверенуверено, что хочешь сегодня сразиться со стихией?
bulgarian: The rain on the roof of our house sounds different from rain on the Deep Woods canopy...

english: Perhaps you might stay home and keep me company instead.
french: Mais les deux me font me sentir comme chez moi.
russian: Но всё равно по-домашнему.
bulgarian: Perhaps you might stay home and keep me company instead.

english: Are you certain you wish to brave the elements today?
french: La pluie qui frappe le toit de notre maison résonne différemment que celle qui vient s'abat sur la canopée de Boissombre...
russian: Дождь стучит по крыше дома совсем не так, как по листве Глубокой чащи...
bulgarian: Are you certain you wish to brave the elements today?

english: Oh, pay me no mind, [Ari].
french: Oh, ne fais pas attention à moi, [Ari].
russian: Ой, не бери в голову, [Ari].
bulgarian: Oh, pay me no mind, [Ari].

english: I am simply a little drowsy.
french: J'ai un peu sommeil, rien de plus.
russian: Я просто слегка сонливый.
bulgarian: I am simply a little drowsy.

english: It would seem my eyelids are heavy, today...
french: Je sens que mes paupières sont lourdes, aujourd'hui...
russian: Сегодня мои веки как будто бы потяжелели.
bulgarian: It would seem my eyelids are heavy, today...

english: More so when I watch it next to you, [Ari].
french: Et encore plus en admirant ce spectacle à tes côtés, [Ari].
russian: Особенно, когда смотрю на него вместе с тобой, [Ari].
bulgarian: More so when I watch it next to you, [Ari].

english: Snow continues to fall. It is very beautiful...
french: La neige continue de tomber. C'est vraiment très joli...
russian: Снегопад всё не утихает. Так красиво...
bulgarian: Snow continues to fall. It is very beautiful...

english: If you have time later, perhaps you can show me how to make a Snow Mortal.
french: Si jamais tu as le temps, tu pourrais peut-être me montrer comment faire un mortel de neige.
russian: Если будет время, покажешь мне, как слепить муляж смертного из снега?
bulgarian: If you have time later, perhaps you can show me how to make a Snow Mortal.

english: Did you see? It is snowing outside.
french: Tu as vu ? Il neige, dehors.
russian:
Видели

ВиделаВиделВидело? На улице снегопад.
bulgarian: Did you see? It is snowing outside.

english: Perhaps a walk into town, or an excursion to the Deep Woods...
french: J'irai peut-être faire un tour en ville, ou une sortie à Boissombre...
russian: Может, прогуляться по городу или выбраться в Глубокую чащу...
bulgarian: Perhaps a walk into town, or an excursion to the Deep Woods...

english: Now, what shall I make of the day?
french: Alors, à quoi vais-je employer ma journée ?
russian: Итак, чем мне заняться сегодня?
bulgarian: Now, what shall I make of the day?

english: Well. Tomorrow is another day, is it not?
french: Enfin, demain sera un autre jour, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Что ж, завтра будет новый день!
bulgarian: Well. Tomorrow is another day, is it not?

english: I had planned for a busy day, but instead found myself distracted by a troublesome composition.
french: J'avais des choses de prévues aujourd'hui, mais une de mes compositions m'a pris tout mon temps.
russian: Я запланировал на сегодня дела, но отвлёкся на кое-какую замысловатую композицию.
bulgarian: I had planned for a busy day, but instead found myself distracted by a troublesome composition.

english: I did not know my heart could become fuller still.
french: Je ne pensais pas que mon cœur pourrait être aussi comblé.
russian: Оказалось, моё сердце вмещает ещё больше радости.
bulgarian: I did not know my heart could become fuller still.

english: A spring evening, spent with you.
french: Passer une soirée de printemps en ta compagnie...
russian: Ах, весенний вечер с тобой вдвоём!
bulgarian: A spring evening, spent with you.

english: It is understandable, but I do wish they would be more mindful of their sleeping neighbors.
french: Cela se comprend, mais j'aimerais qu'ils soient plus attentifs aux voisins qui dorment encore.
russian: Я могу их понять, но хотелось бы попросить их быть повнимательнее к спящим соседям.
bulgarian: It is understandable, but I do wish they would be more mindful of their sleeping neighbors.

english: Myself included.
french: Moi, par exemple.
russian: В том числе ко мне.
bulgarian: Myself included.

english: The birds are waking up earlier now that it is spring...
french: Maintenant que le printemps est là, les oiseaux se réveillent plus tôt...
russian: Птицы стали просыпаться раньше, ведь пришла весна...
bulgarian: The birds are waking up earlier now that it is spring...

english: A bright sky, a field in bloom...
french: Un ciel dégagé, un champ en pleine éclosion...
russian: Ясное небо, цветущее поле...
bulgarian: A bright sky, a field in bloom...

english: It warms the heart.
french: Comme c'est agréable.
russian: Сердце радуется.
bulgarian: It warms the heart.

english: It is a fine spring morning, is it not?
french: Quelle belle matinée printanière, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Какое прекрасное весеннее утро, правда?
bulgarian: It is a fine spring morning, is it not?

english: I would be grateful for an evening breeze.
french: Une petite brise du soir serait la bienvenue.
russian: Я был бы рад вечернему ветерку.
bulgarian: I would be grateful for an evening breeze.

english: This heat is rather relentless.
french: La chaleur persiste.
russian: Жара почти нестерпимая.
bulgarian: This heat is rather relentless.

english: If not, I can come and hold you. That will surely bring your body temperature down.
french: Si c'est le cas, je peux t'étreindre. Cela fera sans doute baisser ta température corporelle.
russian: Если нет, я могу обнять тебя. Тогда твоя температура наверняка опустится.
bulgarian: If not, I can come and hold you. That will surely bring your body temperature down.

english: Or will it go up?
french: Ou est-ce que ça la fera monter ?
russian: Или наоборот возрастёт?
bulgarian: Or will it go up?

english: It is a hot summer, even as the sun sets. Are you cool enough, [Ari]?
french: La chaleur estivale est étouffante, même lorsque le soleil se couche. Tu n'as pas trop chaud, [Ari] ?
russian: Летом жарко, даже после заката. Тебе достаточно прохладно, [Ari]?
bulgarian: It is a hot summer, even as the sun sets. Are you cool enough, [Ari]?

english: Take care in this heat, [Ari].
french: Fais attention à toi, [Ari].
russian: Будь осторожнее в такую жару, [Ari].
bulgarian: Take care in this heat, [Ari].

english: It is rather hot today, and the sun climbs higher still.
french: Il fait déjà chaud aujourd'hui, et le soleil n'a pas encore atteint son zénith.
russian: Сегодня уже довольно жарко, а солнце ещё не дошло до зенита.
bulgarian: It is rather hot today, and the sun climbs higher still.

english: I suppose a dragon does not forget the joy of sunning oneself, no matter what form they take.
french: Je suppose que, quelle que soit sa forme, un dragon n'oublie jamais combien il est agréable de s'exposer au soleil.
russian: Полагаю, дракону не под силу забыть, как приятно греться под солнцем. И обличье тут ни при чём.
bulgarian: I suppose a dragon does not forget the joy of sunning oneself, no matter what form they take.

english: I do enjoy the warmth of summer...
french: J'aime la chaleur de l'été...
russian: Мне нравится летнее тепло...
bulgarian: I do enjoy the warmth of summer...

english: But winter nights... are not so bad these days.
french: Mais les nuits d'hiver sont loin d'être désagréables.
russian: А вот зимние ночи... уже гораздо лучше.
bulgarian: But winter nights... are not so bad these days.

english: Why's that?
french: Et pourquoi ?
russian: Почему же?
bulgarian: Why's that?

english: We don't have to wait until bed to cuddle.
french: Pas la peine d'attendre de se coucher pour se faire des câlins.
russian: Мы можем пойти обниматься, не дожидаясь ночи.
bulgarian: We don't have to wait until bed to cuddle.

english: Because you are very good at keeping me warm, [Ari].
french: Parce que tu sais très bien t'y prendre pour me réchauffer, [Ari].
russian: Потому что у тебя отлично получается меня согревать, [Ari].
bulgarian: Because you are very good at keeping me warm, [Ari].

english: Oh! Is that so?
french: Oh ! Vraiment ?
russian: Ого! В самом деле?
bulgarian: Oh! Is that so?

english: Then maybe...
french: Eh bien, dans ce cas...
russian: Тогда, быть может...
bulgarian: Then maybe...

english: Winter evenings are still difficult for me.
french: J'ai encore du mal à m'adapter aux soirées d'hiver.
russian: Я до сих пор не очень хорошо переношу зимние вечера.
bulgarian: Winter evenings are still difficult for me.

english: I think it must be... you.
french: Je crois que c'est grâce à toi.
russian: Думаю, это тяга... к тебе.
bulgarian: I think it must be... you.

english: There is something so inviting about being home in the winter...
french: L'hiver donne vraiment envie de rester à la maison...
russian: Зимой так и тянет отсиживаться дома...
bulgarian: There is something so inviting about being home in the winter...

english: But knowing I will end the day coiled in warm blankets with you...
french: Mais je sais que je terminerai la journée tout contre toi, sous une couverture bien douillette.
russian: Но я знаю, что вечером я завернусь в одеяло вместе с тобой...
bulgarian: But knowing I will end the day coiled in warm blankets with you...

english: I will persevere.
french: Alors, je prends sur moi.
russian: Так что я потерплю.
bulgarian: I will persevere.

english: Oh, I do not enjoy the chill of winter.
french: Oh, je n'aime pas la froideur de l'hiver.
russian: О, мне не нравятся зимние холода.
bulgarian: Oh, I do not enjoy the chill of winter.

english: And you take extra care to help me stay warm in this season.
french: Et tu prends encore plus soin de me réchauffer à cette saison.
russian: К тому же ты так заботишься, чтобы мне было тепло.
bulgarian: And you take extra care to help me stay warm in this season.

english: For that reason, it is beginning to grow on me.
french: C'est pour cela que je commence à l'apprécier.
russian: Поэтому этот сезон тоже начинает мне нравиться.
bulgarian: For that reason, it is beginning to grow on me.

english: Winter is difficult, but it is beautiful.
french: L'hiver est une saison difficile, mais les paysages sont magnifiques.
russian: Зима — суровое время, но очень красивое.
bulgarian: Winter is difficult, but it is beautiful.

english: Unfortunately, this was written by someone with atrocious handwriting.
french: Malheureusement, l'auteur de ce parchemin avait une écriture épouvantable.
russian: К сожалению, этот экземпляр писал кто-то с ужасным почерком.
bulgarian: Unfortunately, this was written by someone with atrocious handwriting.

english: Eiland has asked me to do some work translating a scroll he recently acquired... Normally, such a thing would be a small task for me.
french: Eiland m'a demandé de traduire un parchemin qu'il s'est récemment procuré. En temps normaux, une telle tâche ne présenterait aucune difficulté pour moi.
russian: Эйланд недавно приобрёл один свиток и попросил меня помочь с переводом... Обычно для меня это нетрудная работа.
bulgarian: Eiland has asked me to do some work translating a scroll he recently acquired... Normally, such a thing would be a small task for me.

english: Pray, do not look yet. It is not finished.
french: Ne regarde pas, je te prie. Elle n'est pas encore terminée.
russian: Прошу тебя, не смотри. Она ещё не завершена.
bulgarian: Pray, do not look yet. It is not finished.

english: I am once more trying my hand at writing you a song...
french: J'essaie de prendre à nouveau la plume pour t'écrire une chanson.
russian: Я вновь решил попробовать сочинить для тебя песню...
bulgarian: I am once more trying my hand at writing you a song...

english: They do gather... an amount of dust...
french: Il est normal qu'un peu de poussière s'accumule.
russian: На них скапливается... Некоторое количество пыли...
bulgarian: They do gather... an amount of dust...

english: I suppose when you keep a collection of scrolls in one place for untold ages...
french: Si une collection de parchemins est stockée au même endroit pendant une très longue période...
russian: Видимо, если много веков держать собрание свитков в одном месте...
bulgarian: I suppose when you keep a collection of scrolls in one place for untold ages...

english: This collection in particular seems to be comprised of business ledgers... inventory data, timesheets...
french: Ce recueil en particulier semble composé de livres de comptes, d'inventaires, de feuilles d'heures...
russian: Например, это собрание, кажется, целиком состоит из бухгалтерских книг... инвентарных записей, графиков...
bulgarian: This collection in particular seems to be comprised of business ledgers... inventory data, timesheets...

english: Perhaps Adeline will find it interesting?
french: Adeline trouvera peut-être ça intéressant ?
russian: Возможно, Аделине будет интересно взглянуть.
bulgarian: Perhaps Adeline will find it interesting?

english: As of late, I have turned my energy towards translation of old texts.
french: Ces derniers temps, j'emploie mon énergie à traduire des textes anciens.
russian: В последнее время я решил обратить свои усилия к переводу древних текстов.
bulgarian: As of late, I have turned my energy towards translation of old texts.

english: It is a daunting task, catching up on all of this history... even as I learn of current events, time marches ever forward.
french: Passer en revue des pans entiers de l'histoire est un travail titanesque. Et pendant ce temps-là, le temps poursuit sa course inexorable.
russian: Пытаться нагнать историю — удручающая задача... Пока я узнаю о текущих событиях, время неумолимо движется дальше.
bulgarian: It is a daunting task, catching up on all of this history... even as I learn of current events, time marches ever forward.

english: I am doing my best to catch up on all that transpired while I slept.
french: Je fais de mon mieux pour rattraper tout ce que j'ai raté pendant mon sommeil.
russian: Я изо всех сил стараюсь изучить всё, что произошло, пока я спал.
bulgarian: I am doing my best to catch up on all that transpired while I slept.

english: Now that I reside on a farmstead, I am studying all I can find about ranching and crop management.
french: Maintenant que j'habite une ferme, je veux tout connaître de l'élevage et des cultures.
russian: Сейчас я обитаю на ферме, а потому изучаю животноводство и сельскохозяйственные культуры.
bulgarian: Now that I reside on a farmstead, I am studying all I can find about ranching and crop management.

english: It would please me to learn how best to help.
french: Je serais si heureux de pouvoir t'être utile.
russian: Мне хочется узнать, как я могу быть тебе полезен.
bulgarian: It would please me to learn how best to help.

english: To live fully is to forever play the part of the student.
french: Pour profiter pleinement de la vie, il faut toujours avoir soif de connaissances.
russian: Жить полноценной жизнью — значит всегда быть учеником.
bulgarian: To live fully is to forever play the part of the student.

english: Poetry, music, the culinary arts... mortals have found countless modes to convey the way they see the world.
french: Poésie, musique, gastronomie... Les mortels ont bien des façons de transmettre leur perception du monde.
russian: Поэзия, музыка, кулинарное искусство... Смертные придумали великое множество способов показать своё мироощущение.
bulgarian: Poetry, music, the culinary arts... mortals have found countless modes to convey the way they see the world.

english: I am excited to experience all I can.
french: J'ai hâte de m'essayer à tout cela.
russian: Мне хочется попробовать всё, к чему я способен.
bulgarian: I am excited to experience all I can.

english: The scope and breadth of personal expression has grown considerably while I slept.
french: La diversité des moyens d'expression s'est considérablement élargie pendant mon sommeil.
russian: Масшабы и широта самовыражения существенно выросли, пока я спал.
bulgarian: The scope and breadth of personal expression has grown considerably while I slept.

english: (Caldarus plucks haltingly at his lute, occasionally returning to the beginning of the melody. It seems that he is composing something.)
french: (Caldarus pince les cordes de son luth de manière hésitante, reprenant parfois le morceau depuis le début. Il semble en pleine composition.)
russian: (Кальдарус отрывисто цепляет струны, постоянно возвращается к началу мелодии. Кажется, он что-то сочиняет.)
bulgarian: (Caldarus plucks haltingly at his lute, occasionally returning to the beginning of the melody. It seems that he is composing something.)

english: (Caldarus plays a bright staccato in a major key. His tail swishes behind him to keep the rhythm, rather like a metronome.)
french: (Caldarus joue une mélodie enjouée. Sa queue se balance en rythme derrière lui, à la manière d'un métronome.)
russian: (Кальдарус играет яркое мажорное стаккато. Хвост ритмично раскачивается из стороны в сторону позади него, слегка напоминая метроном.)
bulgarian: (Caldarus plays a bright staccato in a major key. His tail swishes behind him to keep the rhythm, rather like a metronome.)

english: (Caldarus rapidly strums a series of chords. From the tune, you recognize it as a local festival song.)
french: (Caldarus plaque rapidement une série d'accords. Vous reconnaissez un air joué lors des fêtes locales.)
russian: (Кальдарус бьёт по струнам, резво наигрывая аккорд за аккордом. По мелодии вы узнаёте одну из местных фестивальных песен.)
bulgarian: (Caldarus rapidly strums a series of chords. From the tune, you recognize it as a local festival song.)

english: It has been inspiring me to compose new music.
french: Je m'en suis inspiré pour composer de nouveaux morceaux.
russian: Они вдохновляют меня сочинять новую музыку.
bulgarian: It has been inspiring me to compose new music.

english: Now that we share a home together... my soul feels nourished. Happy feelings, and new feelings.
french: Depuis que nous vivons ensemble, je sens mon âme revivre. Je fais l'expérience de sentiments nouveaux et agréables.
russian: Теперь, когда у нас с тобой общий дом... Моя душа насытилась. Это хорошие новые переживания.
bulgarian: Now that we share a home together... my soul feels nourished. Happy feelings, and new feelings.

english: I believe the animals of [farm_name] are the cutest in all of Mistria... but alas, I am not one of the judges.
bulgarian: I believe the animals of [farm_name] are the cutest in all of Mistria... but alas, I am not one of the judges.

english: Ah, good morning. The $Animal Festival$ is today, is it not?
bulgarian: Ah, good morning. The $Animal Festival$ is today, is it not?

english: If you would like a partner to dance with... my hand and heart will always belong to you.
bulgarian: If you would like a partner to dance with... my hand and heart will always belong to you.

english: Good morning, my love... are you looking forward to the $Harvest Festival$?
bulgarian: Good morning, my love... are you looking forward to the $Harvest Festival$?

english: It would be a joy to watch the stars with you, [Ari].
bulgarian: It would be a joy to watch the stars with you, [Ari].

english: The $Starbinding Ceremony$ is this evening...
bulgarian: The $Starbinding Ceremony$ is this evening...

english: I have as well... but I do not believe I am as adept at foraging as you.
bulgarian: I have as well... but I do not believe I am as adept at foraging as you.

english: I am curious to see who triumphs this year. Perhaps there will be an upset.
bulgarian: I am curious to see who triumphs this year. Perhaps there will be an upset.

english: Have you been collecting $Breath of Spring$ for the $Spring Festival$?
bulgarian: Have you been collecting $Breath of Spring$ for the $Spring Festival$?

english: I may stop by Darcy's booth. Her confections are always delightful.
bulgarian: I may stop by Darcy's booth. Her confections are always delightful.

english: Ah, Saturday is upon us once again.
bulgarian: Ah, Saturday is upon us once again.

english: I always enjoy browsing the textiles in Louis' booth.
bulgarian: I always enjoy browsing the textiles in Louis' booth.

english: I am excited to attend the Saturday Market today.
bulgarian: I am excited to attend the Saturday Market today.

english: I am considering visiting Merri's Antique stall today... though, I am not certain what constitutes an antique these days. Is it age? Style?
bulgarian: I am considering visiting Merri's Antique stall today... though, I am not certain what constitutes an antique these days. Is it age? Style?

english: Depending on the definition, perhaps I count as an antique as well.
bulgarian: Depending on the definition, perhaps I count as an antique as well.

english: Ah. Good morning, [Ari].
bulgarian: Ah. Good morning, [Ari].

english: Perhaps I will visit Stillwell's booth at the Market today... it is curious to see a person of his talents in such a venue.
bulgarian: Perhaps I will visit Stillwell's booth at the Market today... it is curious to see a person of his talents in such a venue.

english: Still... I am glad there is yet a place for oracles in this age.
bulgarian: Still... I am glad there is yet a place for oracles in this age.

english: Good morning, [Ari].
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari].

english: My attempts at his $Cooking Challenge$ seem to vex him...
bulgarian: My attempts at his $Cooking Challenge$ seem to vex him...

english: Will you go to the Saturday Market today? I may stop by Taliferro's booth again.
bulgarian: Will you go to the Saturday Market today? I may stop by Taliferro's booth again.

english: Vera frequently asks to style my hair... but I am rather fond of its length and style.
bulgarian: Vera frequently asks to style my hair... but I am rather fond of its length and style.

english: At the moment, the only person who I would allow to style my hair is you.
bulgarian: At the moment, the only person who I would allow to style my hair is you.

english: Good morning, [Ari]. Are you thinking of attending the Saturday Market today?
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari]. Are you thinking of attending the Saturday Market today?

english: Everyone has such curious reactions to him. It is interesting to watch.
bulgarian: Everyone has such curious reactions to him. It is interesting to watch.

english: Perhaps I will stop by Wheedle's booth at the Market today...
bulgarian: Perhaps I will stop by Wheedle's booth at the Market today...

english: If you happen to stop by Zorel's booth, do not hesitate to bring home more of her music. It makes the home more lively.
bulgarian: If you happen to stop by Zorel's booth, do not hesitate to bring home more of her music. It makes the home more lively.

english: Saturdays are always lively, are they not?
bulgarian: Saturdays are always lively, are they not?

english: To think, every day we share will be happier than the last. Yes...
french: Chaque jour passé ensemble sera plus joyeux que le précédent. Oui...
russian: Представь: каждый день вдвоём будет лучше предыдущего. Да...
bulgarian: To think, every day we share will be happier than the last. Yes...

english: Every day we share, I am born anew.
french: Chaque journée à tes côtés est comme une renaissance.
russian: Каждый день с тобой я будто рождаюсь заново.
bulgarian: Every day we share, I am born anew.

english: I can't wait for our future together!
french: J'ai hâte de découvrir ce que l'avenir nous réserve !
russian: Я хочу войти в будещее вместе с тобой!
bulgarian: I can't wait for our future together!

english: I'm so happy you're finally mine.
french: Quel bonheur de savoir que tu es enfin mon époux !
russian:
Наконец-то ты мой. Я так

счастливы

счастливасчастливсчастливо!
bulgarian: I'm so happy you're finally mine.

english: Nor I.
french: Moi aussi.
russian: И я — с тобой.
bulgarian: Nor I.

english: Once, I saw my future as an unchanging, immutable path... but I could not have been more wrong.
french: Autrefois, mon avenir était linéaire et immuable... Comme je me trompais.
russian: Когда-то будущее представлялось мне как неизменный, незыблемый путь... Но я крайне ошибался.
bulgarian: Once, I saw my future as an unchanging, immutable path... but I could not have been more wrong.

english: And you are the one who awakened me to that world of myriad possibilities.
french: C'est toi qui m'as éveillé à ce monde de possibles.
russian:
Именно ты

показали

показалапоказалпоказало мне, что мир полон бесчисленных возможностей.
bulgarian: And you are the one who awakened me to that world of myriad possibilities.

english: I am yours.
french: Je suis tout à toi.
russian: Воистину я твой.
bulgarian: I am yours.

english: My heart and body both, for as long as I draw breath.
french: Mon cœur comme mon corps t'appartiennent, jusqu'à mon dernier souffle.
russian: Сердцем и телом, навеки, пока дышу.
bulgarian: My heart and body both, for as long as I draw breath.

english: I am still accepting that yesterday was no dream... no fantasy conjured by the mind of an eternally slumbering dragon.
french: Je suis encore en train de me faire à l'idée que la journée d'hier n'était pas un rêve ni une illusion créée par l'esprit d'un dragon endormi pour l'éternité.
russian: Я до сих пор осознаю, что вчерашний день не сон... И не разыгравшаяся фантазия дракона, погружённого в вечную дремоту.
bulgarian: I am still accepting that yesterday was no dream... no fantasy conjured by the mind of an eternally slumbering dragon.

english: It is astonishing how large [farm_name] is. I cannot comprehend how you have single-handedly accomplished so much.
french: Je n'imaginais pas que le domaine [farm_name] était si grand. Je ne comprends pas comment tu as fait tout cela sans aide.
russian: «[farm_name]» поистине поразительных размеров. Я даже не представляю, как тебе в одиночку удалось сделать так много.
bulgarian: It is astonishing how large [farm_name] is. I cannot comprehend how you have single-handedly accomplished so much.

english: Do not hesitate to put me to work. I am eager to learn this new occupation.
french: N'hésite pas à me mettre à contribution. J'ai hâte de m'adonner à ce nouveau passe-temps.
russian: Не стесняйся привлекать меня к работе. Я с радостью изучу новое занятие.
bulgarian: Do not hesitate to put me to work. I am eager to learn this new occupation.

english: I have finished exploring the entire farmstead...
french: J'ai enfin exploré toute la ferme.
russian: Я наконец обошёл всё твоё хозяйство...
bulgarian: I have finished exploring the entire farmstead...

english: I must be more diligent in stooping as I pass between rooms. I am afraid my height is not compatible with the doorways.
french: Je dois penser à me baisser lorsque je passe d'une pièce à l'autre. Ma taille n'est pas adaptée aux encadrements de portes de mortels.
russian: Мне надо аккуратнее нагибаться в переходах между комнатами. Боюсь, эти дверные проёмы несовместимы с моим ростом.
bulgarian: I must be more diligent in stooping as I pass between rooms. I am afraid my height is not compatible with the doorways.

english: Are you okay?
french: Est-ce que ça va ?
russian: Ты в порядке?
bulgarian: Are you okay?

english: I'll remake all the doors to be taller!
french: Je vais agrandir toutes les portes !
russian: Я переделаю двери, чтобы были повыше!
bulgarian: I'll remake all the doors to be taller!

english: Oh, yes... only my pride was hurt.
french: Oh, oui... Seul mon amour-propre en a pris un coup.
russian: О, да... Пострадала лишь моя гордость.
bulgarian: Oh, yes... only my pride was hurt.

english: And the doorframe as well... it might have acquired some damage from jousting with my horns.
french: Et l'encadrement de la porte aussi... Il est possible que mes cornes l'aient endommagé.
russian: И немного косяк... Возможно, на нём остался след от поединка с моими рогами.
bulgarian: And the doorframe as well... it might have acquired some damage from jousting with my horns.

english: Do not worry... I will learn in time. You will find me to be quite adaptable.
french: Ne t'inquiète pas... je finirai par apprendre avec le temps.
russian: Не переживай... Со временем я привыкну. Вот увидишь, я умею подстраиваться под обстановку.
bulgarian: Do not worry... I will learn in time. You will find me to be quite adaptable.

english: It is kind of you to offer, but there is no need. I must simply become more accustomed to our new home together.
french: C'est gentil de le proposer, mais ça ne sera pas nécessaire. Je dois simplement m'habituer à ma nouvelle demeure.
russian: Это заботливое предложение, но в нём нет нужды. Мне просто нужно привыкнуть к нашему совместному жилищу.
bulgarian: It is kind of you to offer, but there is no need. I must simply become more accustomed to our new home together.

english: Though, you may want to look at the doorframe. It might have acquired some damage from jousting with my horns.
french: En revanche, tu devrais peut-être jeter un œil à l'encadrement de la porte. Il est possible que mes cornes l'aient endommagé.
russian: Но тебе стоит обратить внимание на косяк. Возможно, на нём остался след от поединка с моими рогами.
bulgarian: Though, you may want to look at the doorframe. It might have acquired some damage from jousting with my horns.

english: It is a temporary situation. Do not worry... I learn quickly. You will find me to be quite adaptable.
french: Ça ne durera pas. Ne te fais pas de souci... J'apprends vite. Tu verras que je m'adapte plutôt facilement.
russian: Это временное неудобство. Не переживай... Вскоре я привыкну. Вот увидишь, я умею подстраиваться под обстановку.
bulgarian: It is a temporary situation. Do not worry... I learn quickly. You will find me to be quite adaptable.

english: Ah, [Ari]. I was drowsy this morning and bonked my horns on the doorframe once again...
french: Ah, [Ari]. Je n'étais pas bien réveillé ce matin, et j'ai encore heurté le haut du chambranle avec mes cornes.
russian: Ох, [Ari]. Я с утра был сонный и снова стукнулся рогами о косяк...
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]. I was drowsy this morning and bonked my horns on the doorframe once again...

english: No matter the season, they seem to be susceptible to a chill.
french: Quelle que soit la saison, elles semblent toujours sensibles au froid.
russian: Видимо, они чувствительны к сквозняку в любое время года.
bulgarian: No matter the season, they seem to be susceptible to a chill.

english: Let me warm them up!
french: Laisse-moi les réchauffer !
russian: Давай я их согрею!
bulgarian: Let me warm them up!

english: Do you want to hold hands?
french: Tu veux qu'on se tienne la main ?
russian: Хочешь, возьмёмся за руки?
bulgarian: Do you want to hold hands?

english: Yes, I would like that very much.
french: Oui, j'aimerais beaucoup.
russian: Да, это было бы замечательно.
bulgarian: Yes, I would like that very much.

english: It would please me to hold your hands regardless.
french: Te tenir la main est un plaisir en toutes circonstances.
russian: Мне в любом случае хотелось бы взять тебя за руки.
bulgarian: It would please me to hold your hands regardless.

english: Such an idea is so very tempting...
french: Cette idée est très tentante...
russian: Это предложение... весьма соблазнительно.
bulgarian: Such an idea is so very tempting...

english: Yes, I would like that very much.
french: Oui, j'aimerais beaucoup.
russian: Да, это было бы замечательно.
bulgarian: Yes, I would like that very much.

english: Ah, my hands feel a bit stiff today.
french: Ah, mes mains sont un peu raides, aujourd'hui.
russian: Ах, у меня сегодня слегка немеют руки.
bulgarian: Ah, my hands feel a bit stiff today.

english: Dragons tend to be quite solitary, as you well know.
french: Les dragons sont des créatures solitaires, comme tu le sais.
russian: Как тебе известно, драконы — довольно замкнутые создания.
bulgarian: Dragons tend to be quite solitary, as you well know.

english: As a result, I do not have a significant frame of reference to draw upon regarding the norms of marriage.
french: C'est pour cela que je ne sais pas grand-chose de ce qui se fait ou ne se fait pas dans un mariage.
russian: В связи с этим обстоятельством мне недостаёт ценностных ориентиров, когда речь заходит о брачных нормах.
bulgarian: As a result, I do not have a significant frame of reference to draw upon regarding the norms of marriage.

english: All this to say, I hope you will be patient with me, [Ari].
french: Ce que je veux dire, c'est que j'espère que tu feras preuve de patience envers moi, [Ari].
russian: Я хочу сказать: пожалуйста, отнесись ко мне с пониманием, [Ari].
bulgarian: All this to say, I hope you will be patient with me, [Ari].

english: Though there is much to learn... I believe we will enjoy doing so together.
french: J'ai beaucoup à apprendre, mais je pense que ce sera amusant ensemble.
russian: Многому ещё предстоит научиться... Но я верю, что вместе это обучение будет приятным.
bulgarian: Though there is much to learn... I believe we will enjoy doing so together.

english: In my long life, I have not known many who I would refer to as family.
french: De toute ma longue vie, rares sont les personnes qui ont vu en moi un membre de sa famille.
russian: За свою долгую жизнь лишь немногих я мог бы назвать своей семьёй.
bulgarian: In my long life, I have not known many who I would refer to as family.

english: You are married to a dragon, after all. One might say it comes with the territory.
french: Tu as pris un dragon pour époux, après tout. C'est dans notre nature.
russian:
В конце концов, ты

взяли

взялавзялвзяло в супруги дракона. Вместе с его территорией, если можно так выразиться.
bulgarian: You are married to a dragon, after all. One might say it comes with the territory.

english: Ah, [Ari]! I hope the occasional plume of smoke in the kitchen is not bothersome to you.
french: Ah, [Ari] ! J'espère qu'un peu de fumée venant de la cuisine ne te dérangera pas.
russian: А, [Ari]! Надеюсь, тебя не смущают клубы дыма, временами доносящиеся с кухни.
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]! I hope the occasional plume of smoke in the kitchen is not bothersome to you.

english: Such a thing is not always true for dragons, in the same way it is not always true for mortals.
french: Cela n'est pas nécessairement vrai chez les dragons ni chez les mortels d'ailleurs.
russian: У драконов это не всегда так, как и у многих смертных.
bulgarian: Such a thing is not always true for dragons, in the same way it is not always true for mortals.

english: But in my case, it is. I am yours forever, [Ari].
french: Mais c'est vrai pour moi. Je serai toujours là, [Ari].
russian: Но в моём случае это правда. Я твой навеки, [Ari].
bulgarian: But in my case, it is. I am yours forever, [Ari].

english: Ryis tells me many species of birds mate for life...
french: Ryis m'a expliqué que de nombreuses espèces d'oiseaux s'unissent pour la vie...
russian: Риз говорит, что многие виды птиц находят партнёров на всю жизнь...
bulgarian: Ryis tells me many species of birds mate for life...

english: I do not know if our binding was decreed by fate, but every day I am grateful for it.
french: J'ignore si c'est le destin qui a décidé de notre union, mais je lui en suis reconnaissant à jamais.
russian: Не знаю, было ли это предрешено судьбой, но каждый день я ей благодарен.
bulgarian: I do not know if our binding was decreed by fate, but every day I am grateful for it.

english: I was always drawn to you!
french: J'ai toujours ressenti une attirance pour toi !
russian: Ты манил меня с самого начала!
bulgarian: I was always drawn to you!

english: Well, you were a handsome statue.
french: À vrai dire, tu n'étais pas mal, pour une statue.
russian: Ну, ты был очень красивой статуей.
bulgarian: Well, you were a handsome statue.

english: Even as a talking statue? Was it my voice?
french: Même en tant que statue douée de parole ? C'était ma voix ?
russian: Даже в виде говорящей статуи? Дело в моём голосе?
bulgarian: Even as a talking statue? Was it my voice?

english: I am glad to know you find me pleasing no matter what form I take.
french: Je suis heureux de savoir que tu me trouves attirant, qu'importe ma forme.
russian: Мне приятно знать, что я мил тебе в любом обличье.
bulgarian: I am glad to know you find me pleasing no matter what form I take.

english: Oh, you must cease teasing.
french: Oh, arrête de me taquiner.
russian: Ой, прекрати дразниться.
bulgarian: Oh, you must cease teasing.

english: You should know better than to provoke a dragon's vanity.
french: Sache qu'il vaut mieux ne pas flatter l'orgueil d'un dragon.
russian: Ты же знаешь: не стоит провоцировать драконье тщеславие.
bulgarian: You should know better than to provoke a dragon's vanity.

english: Since the day you repaired my shrine, you have grounded me, and kept me tethered to the world.
french: Depuis le jour où tu as réparé mon autel, tu as créé un lien indéfectible entre nous et tu m'as ancré dans ce monde.
russian:
С того дня, как ты

отремонтировали

отремонтировалаотремонтировалотремонтировало моё святилище, ты меня
