захватила и привязалазахватил и привязалзахватило и привязало к миру.
bulgarian: Since the day you repaired my shrine, you have grounded me, and kept me tethered to the world.

english: The very sky brightens at <he>his</he><she>her</she><they>their</they><it>its</it><none>[Ari]'s</none> presence... the wind sings in <he>his</he><she>her</she><they>their</they><it>its</it><none>[Ari]'s</none> wake.
french: Sa simple présence a le pouvoir de chasser les nuages... Le vent chante ses louanges à son passage...
russian:
От

их

еёегоего прихода светлеют небеса... ветер несёт за

ними

нейнимним свою песню.
bulgarian: The very sky brightens at <he>his</he><she>her</she><they>their</they><it>its</it><none>[Ari]'s</none> presence... the wind sings in <he>his</he><she>her</she><they>their</they><it>its</it><none>[Ari]'s</none> wake.

english: Careful, Caldarus. Your flattery is working.
french: Attention, Caldarus. Tes flatteries commencent à faire effet.
russian: Осторожно, Кальдарус. Твоя лесть слишком убедительна.
bulgarian: Careful, Caldarus. Your flattery is working.

english: You're definitely MY beguiling creature.
french: C'est TOI, ma séduisante créature.
russian: Это ТЫ моё прелестное созданье.
bulgarian: You're definitely MY beguiling creature.

english: You would call my truthful observations flattery?
french: J'énonce des vérités et tu vois des flatteries ?
russian: Зачем называть лестью мои естественные наблюдения?
bulgarian: You would call my truthful observations flattery?

english: Though, if such words spark your ego... I am pleased to hear it.
french: Eh bien, si de telles paroles flattent ton ego, je suis heureux de le savoir.
russian: Впрочем, если эти слова разжигают твоё самолюбие... Я только рад.
bulgarian: Though, if such words spark your ego... I am pleased to hear it.

english: I have a few more for you, but the rest I'll whisper in your ear.
french: J'en ai d'autres en réserve, mais je te les susurrerai à l'oreille.
russian: У меня есть ещё, но их я прошепчу тебе на ухо.
bulgarian: I have a few more for you, but the rest I'll whisper in your ear.

english: Am I? Perhaps I am.
french: Vraiment ? C'est possible.
russian: Правда? Может, и так.
bulgarian: Am I? Perhaps I am.

english: In that case, we make for a matching pair.
french: Dans ce cas, nous formons un couple idéal.
russian: В таком случае, мы отличная пара.
bulgarian: In that case, we make for a matching pair.

english: Here <he>he is</he><she>she is</she><they>they are</they><it>it is</it><none>[Ari] is</none>... my beguiling creature, returned from the forests and deep earth.
french: <he>Il</he><she>Elle</she><they>Iel</they> est de retour... Ma séduisante créature revient de la forêt ou des entrailles de la terre.
russian:
Вот

они

онаононо... моё прелестное созданье возвратилось из лесов и подземных глубин.
bulgarian: Here <he>he is</he><she>she is</she><they>they are</they><it>it is</it><none>[Ari] is</none>... my beguiling creature, returned from the forests and deep earth.

english: Once, I was fated to exile outside the passage of time. Now, I am free to experience its flow for myself.
french: Mon destin a été, jadis, de m'exiler hors du temps. Désormais, je suis libre d'en étudier le passage.
russian: Когда-то судьба обрекла меня на изгнание за гранью времён. Теперь же я волен сам испытывать течение времени.
bulgarian: Once, I was fated to exile outside the passage of time. Now, I am free to experience its flow for myself.

english: It is a blessing to do so by your side, [Ari].
french: Et en faire l'expérience à tes côtés est une chance, [Ari].
russian: Провести его рядом с тобой — настоящее счастье, [Ari].
bulgarian: It is a blessing to do so by your side, [Ari].

english: It is my hope, in future lives, we might be able to reunite as we are now...
french: J'espère que, dans des vies futures, nous pourrons être ensemble, comme aujourd'hui...
russian: Я надеюсь, что в будущих жизнях мы воссоединимся, как теперь...
bulgarian: It is my hope, in future lives, we might be able to reunite as we are now...

english: And share in this dance again and again.
french: Pour que nous partagions cette danse encore et encore...
russian: И снова и снова будем продолжать наш танец.
bulgarian: And share in this dance again and again.

english: I have come to consider this mortal shape a privilege.
french: Je finis par trouver que cette forme mortelle est un don du ciel.
russian: Я пришёл к мнению, что моё смертное обличье — это положительный момент.
bulgarian: I have come to consider this mortal shape a privilege.

english: You have set a good example, [Ari].
french: Je ne fais que suivre ton exemple, [Ari].
russian: Ты подаёшь хороший пример, [Ari].
bulgarian: You have set a good example, [Ari].

english: Whether it is tending your farm, working the Mines, or minding your friends... I recognize all that you do, and I admire it.
french: Que ce soit à la ferme, à la mine ou en compagnie de tes amis... je vois tout ce que tu fais et je suis plein d'admiration.
russian: Когда ты ухажиаешь за фермой, трудишься в шахтах, заботишься о полях... Я ценю все твои свершения и восхищаюсь ими.
bulgarian: Whether it is tending your farm, working the Mines, or minding your friends... I recognize all that you do, and I admire it.

english: As I grow accustomed to my circumstances, I aspire to spend my days with intention, and gratitude.
french: À mesure que je m'habitue à ma nouvelle condition, j'aspire à passer mes journées avec constance et reconnaissance.
russian: Я всё больше свыкаюсь со своим положением и стремлюсь наполнить каждый день смыслом и благодарностью.
bulgarian: As I grow accustomed to my circumstances, I aspire to spend my days with intention, and gratitude.

english: It is as though I was truly there, and yet...
french: C'est un peu comme si j'étais là, et pourtant...
russian: Такое чувство, будто я правда там был! И всё же...
bulgarian: It is as though I was truly there, and yet...

english: I wonder if my claws are sharp enough?
french: Je me demande si mes griffes sont assez aiguisées...
russian: Интересно, достаточно ли остры мои когти?
bulgarian: I wonder if my claws are sharp enough?

english: I cannot help anticipating my next in-person visit.
bulgarian: I cannot help anticipating my next in-person visit.

english: You're welcome any time!
bulgarian: You're welcome any time!

english: I'll have to tidy up first...
bulgarian: I'll have to tidy up first...

english: One day, I should like to visit your farm in person.
french: Un jour, j'aimerais me rendre à ta ferme en personne.
russian: Однажды я хочу посетить твою ферму лично.
bulgarian: One day, I should like to visit your farm in person.

english: You're welcome any time!
french: Tu seras toujours le bienvenu !
russian: Приходи, когда захочешь!
bulgarian: You're welcome any time!

english: I'll have to tidy up first...
french: Il faudra que je fasse un peu de ménage d'abord...
russian: Мне надо сперва прибраться...
bulgarian: I'll have to tidy up first...

english: Thank you, [Ari].
french: Merci, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari].

english: I enjoy being able to see how your farm changes over time.
bulgarian: I enjoy being able to see how your farm changes over time.

english: I am certain much has changed, and I would be happy to see it.
french: Je suis sûr qu'elle a dû bien changer et je serais heureux de voir cela.
russian: Несомненно, там много нового, я с удовольствием взгляну.
bulgarian: I am certain much has changed, and I would be happy to see it.

english: Perhaps I could even lend you a hand sometime. I have never sheared a sheep before.
bulgarian: Perhaps I could even lend you a hand sometime. I have never sheared a sheep before.

english: And perhaps I could even lend you a hand. I have never sheared a sheep before.
french: Je pourrais même te prêter main-forte, même si je n'ai jamais tondu un mouton.
russian: Возможно, я даже смогу тебе помочь. Я ещё никогда не стриг овец.
bulgarian: And perhaps I could even lend you a hand. I have never sheared a sheep before.

english: I wonder if my claws are sharp enough?
french: Je me demande si mes griffes sont assez aiguisées...
russian: Интересно, достаточно ли остры мои когти?
bulgarian: I wonder if my claws are sharp enough?

english: I will respect your wishes... But your hesitation sparks my curiosity.
french: Je respecte ta volonté... mais ton hésitation attise ma curiosité.
russian: Я не пойду против твоей воли... Однако твоя нерешительность весьма любопытна.
bulgarian: I will respect your wishes... But your hesitation sparks my curiosity.

english: I would know every part of you, [Ari].
french: Je sais tout de toi, [Ari].
russian: Я бы хотел узнать тебя со всех сторон, [Ari].
bulgarian: I would know every part of you, [Ari].

english: And I would be more than happy to help you on the farm. I have never sheared a sheep before.
french: Et je me ferais un plaisir de te prêter main-forte à la ferme. Même si je n'ai jamais tondu un mouton, tu sais.
russian: И я с огромным удовольствием помогу тебе на ферме. Я ещё никогда не стриг овец.
bulgarian: And I would be more than happy to help you on the farm. I have never sheared a sheep before.

english: I was thinking fondly of the days that I spoke to you through my statue on your farm.
french: Je me souvenais avec tendresse de l'époque où je te parlais par l'intermédiaire de ma statue, à la ferme.
russian: Я с нежностью вспоминаю дни, когда я общался с тобой при помощи статуи у тебя на ферме.
bulgarian: I was thinking fondly of the days that I spoke to you through my statue on your farm.

english: Time felt like a long, heavy dream. It was not unpleasant, but it lacked shape and structure.
french: Le temps semblait un rêve long et profond. Rien de désagréable, mais cela manquait de forme et de structure.
russian: Время тогда текло, будто долгий и крепкий сон. Оно не причиняло мне беспокойства, но в этом времени не хватало формы и структуры.
bulgarian: Time felt like a long, heavy dream. It was not unpleasant, but it lacked shape and structure.

english: Your presence was like the first plucking of a string into a vast silence.
french: Ta présence a été comme le premier effleurement d'une corde à travers le silence.
russian: Твоё присутствие я ощутил, как первый звук струны среди океана тишины.
bulgarian: Your presence was like the first plucking of a string into a vast silence.

english: There is no doubt in my mind that only my Dragonsworn could awaken me as you did. Our meeting was kismet.
french: Je suis convaincu que seul un paladin du dragon aurait pu me réveiller comme tu l'as fait. Notre rencontre était écrite.
russian: В моём сердце нет сомнения, что лишь драконоверному дано так меня пробудить. Наша встреча была предначертана.
bulgarian: There is no doubt in my mind that only my Dragonsworn could awaken me as you did. Our meeting was kismet.

english: I do not have strong memories from before you repaired my shrine.
french: J'ai peu de souvenirs du temps avant que tu ne répares mon autel.
russian:
Моя память о времени, пока ты не

восстановили

восстановилавосстановилвосстановило мой храм, слаба.
bulgarian: I do not have strong memories from before you repaired my shrine.

english: Time felt like a long, heavy dream. It was not unpleasant, but it lacked shape and structure.
bulgarian: Time felt like a long, heavy dream. It was not unpleasant, but it lacked shape and structure.

english: Your presence was like the first plucking of a string into a vast silence.
bulgarian: Your presence was like the first plucking of a string into a vast silence.

english: There is no doubt in my mind that only my Dragonsworn could awaken me as you did. Our meeting was kismet.
bulgarian: There is no doubt in my mind that only my Dragonsworn could awaken me as you did. Our meeting was kismet.

english: It feels strange to recall memories from before you repaired my shrine.
bulgarian: It feels strange to recall memories from before you repaired my shrine.

english: But you have no duty to visit me, nor to bring me gifts.
french: Mais rien ne t'oblige à venir me voir ou à m'apporter des offrandes.
russian: Но у тебя нет долга навещать меня и дарить мне подарки.
bulgarian: But you have no duty to visit me, nor to bring me gifts.

english: It pleases me to know that our bond goes beyond obligation.
french: Cela me réchauffe le cœur de savoir que nos liens dépassent la seule obligation.
russian: Мне приятно знать, что наша связь глубже, чем простые обязанности.
bulgarian: It pleases me to know that our bond goes beyond obligation.

english: It is a Dragonsworn's duty to answer the call in a time of need...
french: Le devoir d'un paladin du dragon est de répondre présent en cas de besoin...
russian: Долг драконоверного — прийти на зов, когда настанет трудный час...
bulgarian: It is a Dragonsworn's duty to answer the call in a time of need...

english: Humans are so delicate and susceptible to the elements...
french: Les humains sont si fragiles et si vulnérables face aux éléments...
russian: Люди так хрупки и беззащитны перед лицом сил природы...
bulgarian: Humans are so delicate and susceptible to the elements...

english: Why do you suppose they did not come to grow great scales, as dragons do? Surely this would be a marvelous adaptation.
french: À ton avis, pourquoi n'ont-ils pas d'écailles comme les dragons ? Ce serait une adaptation bienvenue.
russian: Почему, на твой взгляд, они не обзавелись прочной чешуёй, как драконы? Это была бы превосходная адаптация.
bulgarian: Why do you suppose they did not come to grow great scales, as dragons do? Surely this would be a marvelous adaptation.

english: Well, we make clothing and armor instead.
french: Eh bien, on fait des vêtements et des armures.
russian: Ну, вместо этого у нас есть одежда и доспехи.
bulgarian: Well, we make clothing and armor instead.

english: Scales would be really helpful, to be honest...
french: C'est vrai que ce serait pratique d'avoir des écailles...
russian: Честно говоря, чешуя бы правда не помешала...
bulgarian: Scales would be really helpful, to be honest...

english: Yes, of course... the ingenuity of the human mind.
french: Oui, bien entendu... Le génie de l'esprit humain.
russian: Ах, да, конечно... В этом острота человеческого разума.
bulgarian: Yes, of course... the ingenuity of the human mind.

english: To overcome any obstacle with innovation and craft.
french: Surmonter les obstacles grâce à l'innovation et la technologie.
russian: Он позволяет превозмочь любые препятствия с помощью изобретательности и мастерства.
bulgarian: To overcome any obstacle with innovation and craft.

english: I do hope that you next learn to build wings. I cannot currently assist as I am, but I very much recommend the experience of flight.
french: J'espère que vous apprendrez bientôt à fabriquer des ailes. Je ne peux pas vous aider, mais je conseille vivement d'essayer le vol.
russian: Я надеюсь, что следующим вашим изобретением будут крылья. В моей нынешней форме я ничем не могу помочь, но испытать полёт я очень рекомендую.
bulgarian: I do hope that you next learn to build wings. I cannot currently assist as I am, but I very much recommend the experience of flight.

english: Speaking from personal experience, I highly recommend it.
french: Je parle d'expérience en le recommandant vivement.
russian: Очень советую, опробовал на личном опыте.
bulgarian: Speaking from personal experience, I highly recommend it.

english: Though I believe that humans can overcome any obstacle with their innovation and craft.
french: Même si je sais les humains capables de surmonter les obstacles grâce à l'innovation et la technologie.
russian: Хотя я уверен, что люди способны превозмочь любые препятствия с помощью изобретательности и мастерства.
bulgarian: Though I believe that humans can overcome any obstacle with their innovation and craft.

english: I do hope that you next learn to build wings. I cannot currently assist as I am, but I very much recommend the experience of flight.
french: J'espère que vous apprendrez bientôt à fabriquer des ailes. Je ne peux pas vous aider, mais je conseille vivement d'essayer le vol.
russian: Я надеюсь, что следующим вашим изобретением будут крылья. В моей нынешней форме я ничем не могу помочь, но испытать полёт я очень рекомендую.
bulgarian: I do hope that you next learn to build wings. I cannot currently assist as I am, but I very much recommend the experience of flight.

english: Ah, [Ari]. My apologies, I was just ruminating on a strange thought.
french: Ah, [Ari]. Pardonne-moi, mais je ressassais une drôle de pensée.
russian: А, [Ari]. Прошу прощения, мне не даёт покоя одна странная мысль.
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]. My apologies, I was just ruminating on a strange thought.

english: It touches my heart.
french: Cela me touche profondément.
russian: Это согревает мне сердце.
bulgarian: It touches my heart.

english: I hope that you will continue to indulge me.
french: J'espère que tu continueras à me faire ce plaisir.
russian: Надеюсь, ты продолжишь баловать меня своими визитами.
bulgarian: I hope that you will continue to indulge me.

english: You go to such lengths to visit me, knowing that I cannot return the favor.
french: Tu te donnes de la peine pour me rendre visite, alors que je ne peux pas te rendre la pareille.
russian: Ты не жалеешь времени навещать меня, даже зная, что я не могу отплатить тебе тем же.
bulgarian: You go to such lengths to visit me, knowing that I cannot return the favor.

english: It touches my heart to think of it.
bulgarian: It touches my heart to think of it.

english: Now that I may roam freely, I intend to return the favor.
bulgarian: Now that I may roam freely, I intend to return the favor.

english: In the past, you went through such lengths to visit me at home in the $Deep Woods$...
bulgarian: In the past, you went through such lengths to visit me at home in the $Deep Woods$...

english: Bearing such a tempo alone can make the soul feel heavy...
french: Vivre à ce rythme sans autre compagnie que soi-même peut appesantir l'âme...
russian: Если держать такой ритм в одиночестве, на душе может появиться тяжесть...
bulgarian: Bearing such a tempo alone can make the soul feel heavy...

english: But in your company, that slowness becomes welcoming, and that time begins to feel quite leisurely. Even pleasurable.
french: Mais avec toi, cette langueur est agréable, et ces moments deviennent paisibles. Plaisants même.
russian: Но в твоей компании эта тягучесть времени становится приятной и приносит расслабление. И даже удовольствие.
bulgarian: But in your company, that slowness becomes welcoming, and that time begins to feel quite leisurely. Even pleasurable.

english: Here in the heart of the Deep Woods, the passage of time can come to feel slow and deliberate.
french: Ici, au cœur de Boissombre, le passage du temps peut paraître lent et accablant.
russian: Здесь, в сердце Глубокой чащи, ход времени начинает казаться размеренным и неторопливым.
bulgarian: Here in the heart of the Deep Woods, the passage of time can come to feel slow and deliberate.

english: Please, accept this =Spirit Mushroom Tea=, from my hearth.
french: Je te prie d'accepter ce =thé au cérébolet= pour te réchauffer.
russian: Пожалуйста, прими этот =чай из призрачных грибов= с моего очага.
bulgarian: Please, accept this =Spirit Mushroom Tea=, from my hearth.

english: It is possible the tea leaves have oversteeped... but I hope it will warm you, body and mind.
french: Il est possible qu'il ait un peu trop infusé... mais j'espère qu'il te réchauffera aussi bien le corps que l'esprit.
russian: Возможно, листья чая уже перезаварились... Но я надеюсь, он отогреет твоё тело и разум.
bulgarian: It is possible the tea leaves have oversteeped... but I hope it will warm you, body and mind.

english: The winter can be a hardship, even for a dragon. Are you not cold, [Ari]?
french: L'hiver peut s'avérer une épreuve, même pour un dragon. Tu n'as pas froid, [Ari] ?
russian: Зима — нелёгкое время даже для дракона. Тебе не холодно, [Ari]?
bulgarian: The winter can be a hardship, even for a dragon. Are you not cold, [Ari]?

english: Luc has a knowledge of the natural world, and can read the signs of insects to infer much.
french: Luc a une telle compréhension de la nature. Il sait déchiffrer les signes des insectes.
russian: Люк — настоящий эксперт в естествознании. Он многое может выяснить по повадкам насекомых.
bulgarian: Luc has a knowledge of the natural world, and can read the signs of insects to infer much.

english: And I was excited to meet them! Such delightful children.
bulgarian: And I was excited to meet them! Such delightful children.

english: And I would be excited to meet them. I am delighted by children.
french: Je serais heureux de les rencontrer moi aussi. J'aime beaucoup les enfants.
russian: А я был бы рад познакомиться с ними. Мне нравится общаться с детьми.
bulgarian: And I would be excited to meet them. I am delighted by children.

english: They keep the rest of us young...
french: C'est grâce que nous restons jeunes...
russian: Дети и в нас поддерживают молодость...
bulgarian: They keep the rest of us young...

english: They surprise even scholars with their wisdom...
french: Et leur sagesse surprend parfois les érudits...
russian: Неожиданной мудростью они могут удивить и учёных...
bulgarian: They surprise even scholars with their wisdom...

english: And they remind us of what is important.
french: Ils nous rappellent ce qui est important.
russian: А ещё они напоминают нам о самом главном.
bulgarian: And they remind us of what is important.

english: A land with happy children is a good land indeed. That is what Mistria is, and it pleases me to see it.
french: Une terre où les enfants sont heureux est un endroit béni. C'est le cas de Mistria et j'en suis ravi.
russian: Место, где дети счастливы, — это хорошее место. Мне отрадно видеть, что Мистрия именно такова.
bulgarian: A land with happy children is a good land indeed. That is what Mistria is, and it pleases me to see it.

english: Maple grasps the undercurrents of power in the mortal world.
french: Maple comprend les jeux de pouvoir qui sous-tendent le monde des mortels.
russian: Мэйпл знает, как устроены скрытые законы власти в мире смертных.
bulgarian: Maple grasps the undercurrents of power in the mortal world.

english: And Dell's courage binds them in fellowship.
french: Et le courage de Dell cimente leur amitié.
russian: Их союз прочно скрепляет храбрость Делл.
bulgarian: And Dell's courage binds them in fellowship.

english: Together, they have established a Dragonguard at such a young age... and each of them brings their unique skills to the fore.
french: Ensemble et malgré leur jeunesse, ils ont formé une Garde des dragons... et chacun y apporte ses compétences.
russian: В таком юном возрасте они создали свою Драконью стражу... в которой каждый проявляет уникальные навыки.
bulgarian: Together, they have established a Dragonguard at such a young age... and each of them brings their unique skills to the fore.

english: The first Dragonguard would be proud to see their traditions upheld.
bulgarian: The first Dragonguard would be proud to see their traditions upheld.

english: Wait... the Dragonguard was real?
bulgarian: Wait... the Dragonguard was real?

english: They were so excited to meet you!
bulgarian: They were so excited to meet you!

english: The first Dragonguard would be proud to see their traditions upheld.
french: La première Garde des dragons serait heureuse de voir leurs traditions se perpétuer.
russian: Первая Драконья стража могла бы гордиться тем, как блюдут их традиции.
bulgarian: The first Dragonguard would be proud to see their traditions upheld.

english: Wait... the Dragonguard was real?
french: Comment...? La Garde des dragons a vraiment existé ?
russian: Погоди... Драконья стража правда существовала?
bulgarian: Wait... the Dragonguard was real?

english: They would be so excited to meet you.
french: Ils seraient si heureux de te rencontrer.
russian: Они бы так обрадовались, если бы могли с тобой познакомиться.
bulgarian: They would be so excited to meet you.

english: Oh yes.
french: Oh oui.
russian: О, да.
bulgarian: Oh yes.

english: Curiously, they also began as a group of childhood friends.
bulgarian: Curiously, they also began as a group of childhood friends.

english: I do not remember much, but they also began as a group of childhood friends.
french: Mon souvenir est assez vague, mais ils étaient amis d'enfance, eux aussi.
russian: Я немногое помню, но они тоже начинали в детстве как группа друзей.
bulgarian: I do not remember much, but they also began as a group of childhood friends.

english: Though I think Dell, Maple and Luc... may have more of a penchant for mischief.
french: Même si je crois que Dell, Maple et Luc... ont un penchant plus marqué pour les bêtises.
russian: Хотя, кажется, Делл, Мэйпл и Люк... более склонны к шалостям.
bulgarian: Though I think Dell, Maple and Luc... may have more of a penchant for mischief.

english: Oh, a land with happy children is a good land indeed. That is what Mistria is, and it pleases me to see it.
french: Oh, une terre où les enfants sont heureux est un endroit béni. C'est le cas de Mistria et j'en suis ravi.
russian: Но место, где дети счастливы, — это хорошее место. Мне отрадно видеть, что Мистрия именно такова.
bulgarian: Oh, a land with happy children is a good land indeed. That is what Mistria is, and it pleases me to see it.

english: The children of Mistria... they fascinate me.
french: Les enfants de Mistria... me fascinent.
russian: Мистрийские дети... меня просто восхищают.
bulgarian: The children of Mistria... they fascinate me.

english: However, humans are quite different. They have learned to cultivate and savor the world around them.
french: Mais, les humains sont bien différents. Ils ont appris à cultiver ce qui les entoure et à apprécier ces cultures.
russian: Однако люди существенно отличаются. Они окультурили окружающий мир и научились наслаждаться его вкусами.
bulgarian: However, humans are quite different. They have learned to cultivate and savor the world around them.

english: Now I, too, have come to appreciate the omnivorous delights of the human world. It is my wish to experience all it has to offer.
french: Moi aussi, j'ai appris à aimer les délices omnivores qu'offre le monde des humains. Et je souhaite goûter à tout ce qu'on a à me proposer.
russian: А теперь и я перенял всеядные удовольствия мира людей. И я бы хотел бы испытать все его грани.
bulgarian: Now I, too, have come to appreciate the omnivorous delights of the human world. It is my wish to experience all it has to offer.

english: I'll have to cook for you more often!
french: Il faudra que je te fasse la cuisine plus souvent !
russian: Мне надо готовить для тебя почаще!
bulgarian: I'll have to cook for you more often!

english: What did you eat before?
french: Que mangeais-tu avant ?
russian: А чем ты питался до этого?
bulgarian: What did you eat before?

english: Truly?
french: Vraiment ?
russian: В самом деле?
bulgarian: Truly?

english: I am not picky. Due to my culinary misfortunes, I have learned to eat any dish in front of me, no matter how charred.
french: Je ne suis pas difficile. Du fait de mes péripéties culinaires, j'ai appris à manger ce qu'il y avait dans mon assiette, même si c'est complètement brûlé.
russian: Я непривередлив. Вследствие моих неудач в кулинарии я привык есть любое блюдо. Не важно, насколько оно сгорело.
bulgarian: I am not picky. Due to my culinary misfortunes, I have learned to eat any dish in front of me, no matter how charred.

english: I look forward to whatever you may bring. Anything made by your hand is something to savor.
french: J'ai hâte de voir ce que tu apporteras. Tout ce que tu prépares est toujours un régal.
russian: Я с удовольствем приму всё, что ты принесёшь. Вещи, сделанные твоими руками, следует ценить.
bulgarian: I look forward to whatever you may bring. Anything made by your hand is something to savor.

english: I recall eating a great number of fish, fresh from the water and uncooked.
french: Je me rappelle que je mangeais beaucoup de poisson cru, à peine sorti de l'eau.
russian: Помню, что я ел большое количество рыбы — сырой, прямиком из воды.
bulgarian: I recall eating a great number of fish, fresh from the water and uncooked.

english: However, humans have a similar dish, do they not?
french: Les humains mangent un peu la même chose, non ?
russian: Но и у людей встречаются подобные блюда, правда?
bulgarian: However, humans have a similar dish, do they not?

english: Though now that I have experienced the artistry of sashimi, it would be difficult to return to eating them unprepared.
french: Après avoir testé cette merveille que sont les sashimis, j'aurais du mal à me contenter à nouveau de poisson tel quel.
russian: Но теперь, когда я познакомился с искусно приготовленными сасими, возвращаться к неприготовленной рыбе не хочется.
bulgarian: Though now that I have experienced the artistry of sashimi, it would be difficult to return to eating them unprepared.

english: In nature, most creatures only have the means to eat a small variety of things. The bird eats an insect, while the insect eats a leaf.
french: Dans la nature, la plupart des créatures ne se nourrissent que d'une sélection restreinte d'aliments. L'oiseau mange l'insecte et l'insecte, lui, se nourrit de feuilles.
russian: Большинство созданий в природе способны питаться лишь небольшим набором вещей. Птица ест насекомое, а насекомое жуёт листву.
bulgarian: In nature, most creatures only have the means to eat a small variety of things. The bird eats an insect, while the insect eats a leaf.

english: You see, a neighbor has taken to singing quite enthusiastically in the small hours.
french: Un de mes voisins a pris pour habitude de chanter sans retenue dès potron-minet.
russian: Видишь ли, один мой сосед в ранние часы принимается увлечённо петь.
bulgarian: You see, a neighbor has taken to singing quite enthusiastically in the small hours.

english: Unfortunately, this has made my sleep light and my mornings haunted by fatigue.
french: Mon sommeil s'en trouve perturbé et je trouve les matinées difficiles.
russian: К несчастью, от этого мой сон уменьшился, и мои утра теперь наполнены усталостью.
bulgarian: Unfortunately, this has made my sleep light and my mornings haunted by fatigue.

english: I'll help however I can!
french: Je vais t'aider !
russian:
Я

готовы

готоваготовготово помочь чем смогу!
bulgarian: I'll help however I can!

english: Wait, you have neighbors?
french: Tu as des voisins maintenant ?
russian: Погоди, у тебя есть соседи?
bulgarian: Wait, you have neighbors?

english: You have my gratitude, [Ari].
french: Je te remercie, [Ari].
russian: Благодарю тебя, [Ari].
bulgarian: You have my gratitude, [Ari].

english: You see, all creatures of the Deep Woods coexist alongside me quite peacefully.
french: Toutes les créatures de Boissombre vivent à mes côtés sans problème.
russian: Понимаешь, все обитатели Глубокой чащи соседствует со мной вполне мирно.
bulgarian: You see, all creatures of the Deep Woods coexist alongside me quite peacefully.

english: However, if one decides to take up residence underneath my bed, I feel I have the authority to evict them.
french: Mais si l'une d'elles décide d'élire domicile sous mon lit, j'estime avoir le droit de l'en chasser.
russian: Однако, если кто-то решит поселиться под моей кроватью, мне кажется, у меня есть право их изгнать.
bulgarian: However, if one decides to take up residence underneath my bed, I feel I have the authority to evict them.

english: Perhaps you will know what to do with this one?
french: Peut-être sauras-tu quoi faire d'elle ?
russian: Может, ты знаешь, что с ним делать?
bulgarian: Perhaps you will know what to do with this one?

english: Oh, yes. All creatures of the Deep Woods are my neighbors. We coexist quite peacefully.
french: Bien entendu. Toutes les créatures de Boissombre sont mes voisins. Nous coexistons en toute tranquillité.
russian: О, да. Все обитатели Глубокой чащи — мои соседи. Мы вполне мирно сосуществуем.
bulgarian: Oh, yes. All creatures of the Deep Woods are my neighbors. We coexist quite peacefully.

english: However, if one decides to take up residence underneath my bed, I feel I have the authority to evict them.
french: Mais si l'une d'elles décide d'élire domicile sous mon lit, j'estime avoir le droit de l'en chasser.
russian: Однако, если кто-то решит поселиться под моей кроватью, мне кажется, у меня есть право их изгнать.
bulgarian: However, if one decides to take up residence underneath my bed, I feel I have the authority to evict them.

english: Perhaps you will know what to do with this one?
french: Peut-être sauras-tu quoi faire d'elle ?
russian: Может, ты знаешь, что с ними делать?
bulgarian: Perhaps you will know what to do with this one?

english: As of late, I have had... what one might call a social issue.
french: Ces derniers temps, j'ai... ce que l'on pourrait appeler un problème de cohabitation.
russian: В последнее время у меня... как бы сказать, трудности в общении.
bulgarian: As of late, I have had... what one might call a social issue.

english: Now I may admire you as I please, and touch you without fear of doing harm.
french: Maintenant, je peux t'admirer à ma guise et te toucher sans craindre de te blesser.
russian: Я получил возможность любоваться твоим видом и касаться тебя, не страшась навредить.
bulgarian: Now I may admire you as I please, and touch you without fear of doing harm.

english: While adapting to this form has had its challenges, that alone has made it worthwhile.
french: Même si m'approprier ce corps a recelé son lot de difficulté, cela en valait la peine, rien que pour cela.
russian: Освоиться в этом теле было непросто, но одна лишь эта возможность — уже достаточная причина.
bulgarian: While adapting to this form has had its challenges, that alone has made it worthwhile.

english: I have become quite grateful to this form and stature.
french: Je commence à m'habituer à cette nouvelle forme.
russian: Нынешняя форма и сложение моего тела всё более меня радуют.
bulgarian: I have become quite grateful to this form and stature.

english: I know much of the town and its people, but have yet to experience the modern world directly.
french: Je connais bien la ville et ses habitants, mais il me reste à me confronter au monde moderne.
russian: Я много знаю об этом городе и его жителях, но ещё не взаимодействовал с современным миром лично.
bulgarian: I know much of the town and its people, but have yet to experience the modern world directly.

english: Tell me, once I am strong enough to leave this place... what would you like to do first?
french: Dis-moi, une fois que j'aurai la force de quitter cet endroit, qu'aimerais-tu faire en premier ?
russian: Скажи мне: когда я накоплю силы и смогу покинуть это место... что нам стоит сделать в первую очередь?
bulgarian: Tell me, once I am strong enough to leave this place... what would you like to do first?

english: I would introduce you to all of my friends in town!
french: Je te présenterai à tous mes amis en ville.
russian: Хочу представить тебя всем моим друзьям!
bulgarian: I would introduce you to all of my friends in town!

english: I would bring you to my farmhouse and cook dinner for you.
french: Je t'emmènerai à ma ferme et je te préparerai un bon repas.
russian: Хочу привести тебя к себе на ферму и угостить обедом.
bulgarian: I would bring you to my farmhouse and cook dinner for you.

english: That would be a delight.
french: J'en serai ravi.
russian: Это было бы славно.
bulgarian: That would be a delight.

english: It would gladden my heart to finally meet those you cherish most.
french: Je serais heureux d'enfin rencontrer les personnes chères à ton cœur.
russian: Наконец-то познакомиться с теми, кто тебе близок, — отрада моему сердцу.
bulgarian: It would gladden my heart to finally meet those you cherish most.

english: And I believe that understanding how others embrace you would teach me much of your heart.
french: Je crois que comprendre les liens qui t'unissent aux autres m'aideront à mieux cerner ton cœur.
russian: Кроме того, наблюдая, как тебя принимают другие, я смогу лучше понять твоё сердце.
bulgarian: And I believe that understanding how others embrace you would teach me much of your heart.

english: Being welcomed into your den and indulged by the fruits of your labor... It would be a great honor.
french: Être accueilli dans ta demeure et déguster les fruits de ton labeur... J'en serais honoré.
russian: Получить приглашение в твоё жилище и вкусить плоды твоих трудов... Это была бы большая честь для меня.
bulgarian: Being welcomed into your den and indulged by the fruits of your labor... It would be a great honor.

english: I would make certain to repay the favor in any way you desired.
french: Je veillerai à te rendre la pareille de la façon qui te plaira.
russian: За такую щедрость я бы непременно отплатил, чем только пожелаешь.
bulgarian: I would make certain to repay the favor in any way you desired.

english: I have long thought on the state of Mistria outside the confines of the Deep Woods...
french: J'ai longuement réfléchi à Mistria, au-delà des confins de Boissombre...
russian: Я долго размышлял о состоянии Мистрии за пределами Глубокой чащи.
bulgarian: I have long thought on the state of Mistria outside the confines of the Deep Woods...

english: In most regards, I am in fact, quite dextrous.
french: En règle générale, je suis plutôt doué de mes mains.
russian: В большинстве задач я, вообще-то, весьма ловок.
bulgarian: In most regards, I am in fact, quite dextrous.

english: Please do not mistake my ineptitude in the kitchen for clumsiness.
french: Ne prends pas mon inexpérience en cuisine pour de la maladresse.
russian: Пожалуйста, не прими мою кулинарную некомпетентность за неуклюжесть.
bulgarian: Please do not mistake my ineptitude in the kitchen for clumsiness.

english: Do not be shy. There is no question that you cannot ask me.
french: Ne sois pas timide. Tu peux me poser toutes les questions que tu veux.
russian: Не стесняйся. Ты можешь задать мне любой вопрос.
bulgarian: Do not be shy. There is no question that you cannot ask me.

english: Can I touch your tail?
french: Puis-je toucher tes griffes ?
russian: Можно потрогать твой хвост?
bulgarian: Can I touch your tail?

english: Well, I've wondered what your horns are like.
french: J'aimerais voir tes cornes de plus près.
russian: Ну, я размышляю, какие у тебя рога.
bulgarian: Well, I've wondered what your horns are like.

english: My tail? Ahahaha. Of course.
french: Mes griffes ? Ha ha ha. Bien sûr.
russian: Мой хвост? А-ха-ха-ха. Конечно.
bulgarian: My tail? Ahahaha. Of course.

english: You are indeed a curious one, [Ari].
french: Tu es vraiment quelqu'un de curieux, [Ari].
russian: Ты и вправду любопытное создание, [Ari].
bulgarian: You are indeed a curious one, [Ari].

english: As your mate, it is proper that I should return the gesture, but-
french: Étant ton partenaire, je dois te rendre la pareille, mais...
russian: Как твоему партнёру мне полагается совершить ответный жест, но...
bulgarian: As your mate, it is proper that I should return the gesture, but-

english: Well, you will have to suggest an appropriate substitute.
french: Tu devras m'indiquer un endroit qui te paraît convenir...
russian: Видимо, тебе придётся предложить альтернативу.
bulgarian: Well, you will have to suggest an appropriate substitute.

english: My... horns? Ahahaha.
french: Mes... cornes ? Ha ha ha !
russian: Мои... рога? А-ха-ха-ха.
bulgarian: My... horns? Ahahaha.

english: You may take a closer look, if you like.
french: Tu peux les regarder de plus près, si tu veux.
russian: Ты можешь посмотреть поближе, если хочешь.
bulgarian: You may take a closer look, if you like.

english: See? They are quite sturdy.
french: Tu vois ? Elles sont dures.
russian: Видишь? Они весьма крепкие.
bulgarian: See? They are quite sturdy.

english: That gentle touch of yours will do them no harm.
french: Tu peux les toucher, tu ne les abîmeras pas.
russian: Твоё аккуратное касание не может им навредить.
bulgarian: That gentle touch of yours will do them no harm.

english: I have noticed that you look upon me with a warm curiosity at times, [Ari].
french: J'ai remarqué que tu me regardais parfois avec une certaine curiosité, [Ari].
russian: Я заметил, что иногда ты смотришь на меня с неким тёплым любопытством, [Ari].
bulgarian: I have noticed that you look upon me with a warm curiosity at times, [Ari].

english: I am not quite ready to share it. It does not yet meet my standard...
french: J'attendrai un peu avant de la chanter. Elle n'est pas à la hauteur de mes attentes.
russian: Я пока не готов ей поделиться. Она ещё не соответствует моим стандартам.
bulgarian: I am not quite ready to share it. It does not yet meet my standard...

english: It is quite foreign to me. Is this what it is to be vulnerable?
french: C'est nouveau pour moi. Est-ce cela, se sentir vulnérable ?
russian: Незнакомое мне ощущение. Это называется «быть уязвимым»?
bulgarian: It is quite foreign to me. Is this what it is to be vulnerable?

english: And there is... another feeling that causes me to hesitate.
french: Et j'éprouve... un autre sentiment qui me fait hésiter.
russian: И кроме того... ещё одно чувство заставляет меня медлить.
bulgarian: And there is... another feeling that causes me to hesitate.

english: I'll wait as long as it takes!
french: J'attendrai aussi longtemps qu'il le faudra !
russian: Я подожду столько, сколько потребуется!
bulgarian: I'll wait as long as it takes!

english: Are you feeling... shy?
french: Tu ressens de la... timidité ?
russian: Ты испытываешь... смущение?
bulgarian: Are you feeling... shy?

english: I am thankful for your patience.
french: Merci pour ta patience.
russian: Благодарю тебя за терпение.
bulgarian: I am thankful for your patience.

english: I wish to understand you in every way, so I can make a song that truly pleases you...
french: J'essaie de te comprendre pour pouvoir écrire une chanson qui te plaise vraiment...
russian: Я желаю узнать тебя со всех сторон, чтобы сложить песню, которая тебе по-настоящему понравится...
bulgarian: I wish to understand you in every way, so I can make a song that truly pleases you...

english: And yet, the thought of sharing such a song makes me feel... exposed.
french: Et pour autant, l'idée de partager ce morceau avec toi, c'est comme... me mettre à nu.
russian: Однако когда я думаю о том, как буду делиться этой песней, я чувствую... беззащитность.
bulgarian: And yet, the thought of sharing such a song makes me feel... exposed.

english: It is quite foreign to me. Is this what it is to be vulnerable?
french: C'est nouveau pour moi. Est-ce cela, se sentir vulnérable ?
russian: Незнакомое мне ощущение. Это называется «быть уязвимым»?
bulgarian: It is quite foreign to me. Is this what it is to be vulnerable?

english: Is that what it is?
french: Est-ce cela ?
russian: Это называется так?
bulgarian: Is that what it is?

english: I wish to understand you in every way, so I can make a song that truly pleases you...
french: J'essaie de te comprendre pour pouvoir écrire une chanson qui te plaise vraiment...
russian: Я желаю узнать тебя со всех сторон, чтобы сложить песню, которая тебе по-настоящему понравится...
bulgarian: I wish to understand you in every way, so I can make a song that truly pleases you...

english: And yet, the thought of sharing such a song makes me feel... exposed.
french: Et pour autant, l'idée de partager ce morceau avec toi, c'est comme... me mettre à nu.
russian: Однако когда я думаю о том, как буду делиться этой песней, я чувствую... беззащитность.
bulgarian: And yet, the thought of sharing such a song makes me feel... exposed.

english: It is a small thing, but... I have been composing a song for you.
french: Ce n'est pas grand-chose, mais... je t'ai composé une petite chanson.
russian: Это всего лишь безделица, но... Я начал сочинять для тебя песню.
bulgarian: It is a small thing, but... I have been composing a song for you.

english: It is one of the few times I have been truly afraid.
french: C'est une des rares fois où j'ai vraiment eu peur.
russian: Это был один из немногих моментов, когда я правда напугался.
bulgarian: It is one of the few times I have been truly afraid.

english: But you were so brave!
french: Tu as fait preuve d'un tel courage.
russian: Но ты вёл себя так храбро!
bulgarian: But you were so brave!

english: It's a risk I accepted when I became your Dragonsworn.
french: C'est un risque que j'acceptais en devenant ton paladin du dragon.
russian:
Это риск, который я

приняли

принялапринялприняло, став твоим драконоверным.
bulgarian: It's a risk I accepted when I became your Dragonsworn.

english: It was your courage that showed me the way.
french: C'est ton courage qui m'a inspiré.
russian: Я брал пример с твоей смелости.
bulgarian: It was your courage that showed me the way.

english: And it was the depth of my feeling for you that spurred me to action so quickly.
french: Et c'est la profondeur de mes sentiments pour toi qui m'ont poussé à réagir aussi vite.
russian: Кроме того, меня подтолкнула быстро действовать глубина моих чувств к тебе.
bulgarian: And it was the depth of my feeling for you that spurred me to action so quickly.

english: A world without you would be a world dimmed...
french: Sans toi, ce monde n'aurait aucune saveur...
russian: Мир без тебя бы лишился красок...
bulgarian: A world without you would be a world dimmed...

english: Changed as I am, I have no regrets.
french: Même si j'ai changé, je ne regrette rien.
russian: Я изменился, но я об этом не сожалею.
bulgarian: Changed as I am, I have no regrets.

english: That is the courage that first stirred me.
french: C'est ce courage qui m'a ému en premier.
russian: Именно эта твоя смелость так затронула меня.
bulgarian: That is the courage that first stirred me.

english: But to me... you are more than my Dragonsworn.
french: Mais pour moi... tu es plus que mon paladin du dragon.
russian: Но для меня ты... больше, чем драконоверный.
bulgarian: But to me... you are more than my Dragonsworn.

english: A world without you would be a world dimmed...
french: Sans toi, ce monde n'aurait aucune saveur...
russian: Мир без тебя бы лишился красок...
bulgarian: A world without you would be a world dimmed...

english: Changed as I am, I have no regrets.
french: Même si j'ai changé, je ne regrette rien.
russian: Я изменился, но я об этом не сожалею.
bulgarian: Changed as I am, I have no regrets.

english: I do not like to speak of it, but when you were trapped by the $Sealing Scroll$ down in the Mines...
french: Je n'aime pas en parler, mais quand tu as ouvert le $parchemin maudit$ dans la mine...
russian:
Мне не хочется об этом говорить, но когда ты

были захвачены

была захваченабыл захваченбыло захвачено $свитком заточения$ в шахтах...
bulgarian: I do not like to speak of it, but when you were trapped by the $Sealing Scroll$ down in the Mines...

english: I do not know what inspired the Dragon Priestesses to amass such a collection, but I am grateful to them.
french: Je ne sais pas ce qui a poussé les prêtresses dragon à en amasser une telle collection, mais je les en remercie.
russian: Не знаю, что побудило жриц дракона скопить такую коллекцию, но я им благодарен.
bulgarian: I do not know what inspired the Dragon Priestesses to amass such a collection, but I am grateful to them.

english: I don't know much about poetry.
french: Je ne connais pas grand-chose à la poésie.
russian: Я плохо разбираюсь в поэзии.
bulgarian: I don't know much about poetry.

english: I'd love it if you read something to me.
french: J'aimerais beaucoup que tu me lises un poème.
russian:
Я бы

хотели

хотелахотелхотело, чтобы ты мне что-нибудь почитал.
bulgarian: I'd love it if you read something to me.

english: Nothing would bring me greater joy.
french: Rien ne me ferait plus plaisir.
russian: С превеликим удовольствием.
bulgarian: Nothing would bring me greater joy.

english: Nor do I. It is a deficiency I am attempting to overcome through my reading.
french: Moi non plus. C'est une lacune que j'essaie justement de combler.
russian: Как и я. Это недостаток, который я стараюсь превозмочь путём чтения.
bulgarian: Nor do I. It is a deficiency I am attempting to overcome through my reading.

english: May I recite one to you?
french: Puis-je te réciter un poème ?
russian: Могу я прочитать тебе кое-что?
bulgarian: May I recite one to you?

english: "I wish to know you without thought,"
french: « Que ton empreinte soit gravée dans mes pensées, »
russian: «Не мыслию познать тебя желаю»,
bulgarian: "I wish to know you without thought,"

english: "Memorize your spirit within my spirit,"
french: « Qu'au sein de mon esprit elle soit mémorisée, »
russian: «Но изучить твой дух своим».
bulgarian: "Memorize your spirit within my spirit,"

english: "So even in dreams we may never be separated."
french: « Pour qu'en rêves, nous ne soyons jamais séparés. »
russian: «Тогда же и во снах мы будем нераздельны».
bulgarian: "So even in dreams we may never be separated."

english: I hope it is not overly bold to say, but... this one brought you to my mind.
french: J'espère que ce n'est pas trop osé de dire cela, mais... ce poème m'a fait penser à toi.
russian: Надеюсь, это не прозвучит слишком дерзко... Эти строки напомнили мне о тебе.
bulgarian: I hope it is not overly bold to say, but... this one brought you to my mind.

english: I have been inspired of late to delve further into my library's scrolls of poetry.
french: Dernièrement, j'ai eu l'envie de m'intéresser plus encore aux parchemins de poésie présents dans ma bibliothèque.
russian: Недавно я вдохновился поближе ознакомиться со свитками поэзии из моей библиотеки.
bulgarian: I have been inspired of late to delve further into my library's scrolls of poetry.

english: It is strange... I have never thought that of a human before.
french: C'est étrange... Je n'avais jamais pensé cela d'un humain auparavant.
russian: Так странно... Я никогда раньше не замечал такого в людях.
bulgarian: It is strange... I have never thought that of a human before.

english: Perhaps it is more that I am coming to appreciate human grace.
french: C'est peut-être parce que je commence à apprécier la grâce des humains.
russian: Возможно, скорее, я начинаю замечать людскую грацию.
bulgarian: Perhaps it is more that I am coming to appreciate human grace.

english: In either case... you are truly special.
french: Quelle que soit la raison... tu es vraiment à part.
russian:
Так или иначе... Ты

неповторимы

неповториманеповторимнеповторимо.
bulgarian: In either case... you are truly special.

english: You have a dragon's grace today, [Ari].
french: Tu as la grâce d'un dragon aujourd'hui, [Ari].
russian: У тебя сегодня грация дракона, [Ari].
bulgarian: You have a dragon's grace today, [Ari].

english: It has been a dream come true to finally experience it directly.
bulgarian: It has been a dream come true to finally experience it directly.

english: I owe this blessing to you, [Ari].
bulgarian: I owe this blessing to you, [Ari].

english: I'm so happy you could finally meet my friends in town!
bulgarian: I'm so happy you could finally meet my friends in town!

english: I'm so glad I can finally have you over for dinner!
bulgarian: I'm so glad I can finally have you over for dinner!

english: It has been a delight.
bulgarian: It has been a delight.

english: It gladdens my heart that I have finally met those you cherish most.
bulgarian: It gladdens my heart that I have finally met those you cherish most.

english: Seeing how others embrace you has taught me much of your heart.
bulgarian: Seeing how others embrace you has taught me much of your heart.

english: Being welcomed into your den and indulged by the fruits of your labor... It is a great honor.
bulgarian: Being welcomed into your den and indulged by the fruits of your labor... It is a great honor.

english: I will make certain to repay the favor in any way you desire.
bulgarian: I will make certain to repay the favor in any way you desire.

english: I had long desired to explore the Mistria of this modern world...
bulgarian: I had long desired to explore the Mistria of this modern world...

english: It was difficult, in the past... to stand by and watch you go where I could not follow.
bulgarian: It was difficult, in the past... to stand by and watch you go where I could not follow.

english: It can be difficult to stand by and watch you go where I cannot follow.
french: C'est parfois difficile de rester ici et de te voir aller dans des endroits où je ne peux pas te suivre.
russian: Трудно бывает смотреть, как ты уходишь туда, куда я не в силах последовать.
bulgarian: It can be difficult to stand by and watch you go where I cannot follow.

english: But even at those times, you always remained with me in my thoughts.
bulgarian: But even at those times, you always remained with me in my thoughts.

english: But even then, you remain with me in my thoughts.
french: Mais même alors, tu restes dans mes pensées.
russian: Но даже тогда в моих мыслях ты остаёшься со мной.
bulgarian: But even then, you remain with me in my thoughts.

english: There are times that I feel a strong desire to be near you.
french: Il y a des moments où j'ai très envie d'être à tes côtés.
russian: Временами меня одолевает желание быть рядом с тобой.
bulgarian: There are times that I feel a strong desire to be near you.

english: I wish to return the favor.
french: Je souhaite donc te rendre la pareille.
russian: Я бы хотел отплатить тебе тем же.
bulgarian: I wish to return the favor.

english: You saved my life, you don't owe me!
french: Tu m'as sauvé la vie. Tu ne me dois rien !
russian: Ты же спас мою жизнь, так что ничем мне не обязан!
bulgarian: You saved my life, you don't owe me!

english: What do dragons give as gifts?
french: Quel genre de cadeau offrent les dragons ?
russian: А какие у драконов подарки?
bulgarian: What do dragons give as gifts?

english: Such a sentiment was not meant to measure our devotion against one another...
french: Un tel sentiment n'avait pas pour but de mesurer notre dévouement l'un envers l'autre...
russian: Своим высказыванием я не преследовал цель соизмерять нашу преданность друг другу...
bulgarian: Such a sentiment was not meant to measure our devotion against one another...

english: I simply wish to explore what offerings would most please you.
french: Je veux simplement savoir quels présents te feraient le plus plaisir.
russian: Я лишь хочу изучить, какие подношения тебе наиболее приятны.
bulgarian: I simply wish to explore what offerings would most please you.

english: In the meantime, please consider this the first of many.
french: En attendant, considère celui-ci comme le premier d'une longue série.
russian: А пока, пожалуйста, прими первое из них.
bulgarian: In the meantime, please consider this the first of many.

english: I do not seem to recall if such a custom existed.
french: Je ne me rappelle pas qu'une telle coutume existait.
russian: Я не могу вспомнить, чтобы подобный обычай существовал.
bulgarian: I do not seem to recall if such a custom existed.

english: At least, not in my memory.
french: Pas dans mon souvenir, du moins.
russian: По крайней мере, не на моей памяти.
bulgarian: At least, not in my memory.

english: I simply wish to explore what offerings would most please you.
french: Je veux simplement savoir quels présents te feraient le plus plaisir.
russian: Я лишь хочу изучить, какие подношения тебе наиболее приятны.
bulgarian: I simply wish to explore what offerings would most please you.

english: In the meantime, please consider this the first of many.
french: En attendant, considère celui-ci comme le premier d'une longue série.
russian: А пока, пожалуйста, прими первое из них.
bulgarian: In the meantime, please consider this the first of many.

english: [Ari]... you have spared no effort when it comes to bringing me tokens of your affection.
french: [Ari]... Tu ne ménages pas tes efforts pour me donner des preuves de ton affection.
russian: [Ari]... Ты приносишь мне знаки своего расположения, не жалея сил.
bulgarian: [Ari]... you have spared no effort when it comes to bringing me tokens of your affection.

english: I wish to return the favor.
bulgarian: I wish to return the favor.

english: You saved my life, you don't owe me!
bulgarian: You saved my life, you don't owe me!

english: What do dragons give as gifts?
bulgarian: What do dragons give as gifts?

english: Such a sentiment was not meant to measure our devotion against one another...
bulgarian: Such a sentiment was not meant to measure our devotion against one another...

english: I simply wish to explore what offerings would most please you.
bulgarian: I simply wish to explore what offerings would most please you.

english: In the meantime, please consider this the first of many.
bulgarian: In the meantime, please consider this the first of many.

english: Dragons will sometimes hunt for their mates, providing them with offerings of food.
bulgarian: Dragons will sometimes hunt for their mates, providing them with offerings of food.

english: But they do not typically "gift" in the way that humans do.
bulgarian: But they do not typically "gift" in the way that humans do.

english: And yet... I find myself desiring to explore what offerings would most please you.
bulgarian: And yet... I find myself desiring to explore what offerings would most please you.

english: In the meantime, please consider this the first of many.
bulgarian: In the meantime, please consider this the first of many.

english: [Ari]... you have spared no effort when it comes to gifting me with tokens of your affection.
bulgarian: [Ari]... you have spared no effort when it comes to gifting me with tokens of your affection.

english: So I thought I would make =Mont Blanc= for you.
french: Je me suis dit que je t'en préparerais un.
russian: Так что я решил приготовить =монблан= для тебя.
bulgarian: So I thought I would make =Mont Blanc= for you.

english: In my many attempts, I learned that it is quite a complex dish.
french: Après plusieurs tentatives, j'ai compris que c'était un dessert difficile à réaliser.
russian: За много предпринятых попыток я узнал, что это весьма трудоёмкое блюдо.
bulgarian: In my many attempts, I learned that it is quite a complex dish.

english: Try as I might, the end result was always... different than I expected.
french: J'ai eu beau essayer, le résultat était toujours... différent de celui espéré.
bulgarian: Try as I might, the end result was always... different than I expected.

english: Still, I would like for you to have what I could salvage.
french: Cela dit, j'aimerais t'offrir le résultat de mes efforts.
russian: И всё же я бы хотел преподнести тебе то, что мне удалось спасти.
bulgarian: Still, I would like for you to have what I could salvage.

english: I am fond of =Mont Blanc=, and I am fond of you...
french: Je raffole de =mont-blanc= comme je raffole de toi...
russian: Мне нравится =монблан=, и мне нравишься ты...
bulgarian: I am fond of =Mont Blanc=, and I am fond of you...

english: I did not set out to make it quite so spicy...
french: Je n'avais pas prévu qu'elles seraient si piquantes...
russian: Я не предполагал делать их настолько острыми...
bulgarian: I did not set out to make it quite so spicy...

english: I sampled it while I cooked, and it is a bit like casting Dragon's Breath... without magic.
french: J'y ai goûté en cours de préparation. C'était un peu comme un extrait de Souffle du dragon... sans la magie.
russian: Во время готовки я попробовал немного. Похоже на заклинание Дыхание дракона... только без магии.
bulgarian: I sampled it while I cooked, and it is a bit like casting Dragon's Breath... without magic.

english: But do not be alarmed. I made you a drink to go with it.
french: Mais n'aie pas peur. J'ai préparé une boisson pour aller avec.
russian: Но не тревожься. Я также подготовил тебе напиток.
bulgarian: But do not be alarmed. I made you a drink to go with it.

english: I have made you something... $Spicy Water Chestnuts$.
french: Je t'ai préparé quelque chose... Des =châtaignes d'eau épicées=.
russian: Я для тебя кое-что приготовил... Это =острые водяные орешки=.
bulgarian: I have made you something... $Spicy Water Chestnuts$.

english: It seems that humans have a great many ways of expressing these feelings to one another.
french: Il semble que les humains ont d'innombrables façons d'exprimer ce sentiment.
russian: Как видно, у людей существует премного способов выражать их друг другу.
bulgarian: It seems that humans have a great many ways of expressing these feelings to one another.

english: And some are very creative.
french: Et certaines sont très créatives.
russian: И некоторые из них особенно изобретательны.
bulgarian: And some are very creative.

english: Recently, I have expanded the sphere of my reading to include works that explore feelings of romance...
french: Ces derniers temps, j'ai élargi mes lectures pour y inclure des œuvres explorant le sentiment de l'amour...
russian: Недавно я расширил круг своих читательских интересов до работ, исследующих романтические чувства...
bulgarian: Recently, I have expanded the sphere of my reading to include works that explore feelings of romance...

english: And yet, I feel it return to me whenever you seek me out.
french: Et pourtant, j'ai l'impression qu'il ne bat vraiment que lorsque je te vois.
russian: И всё же я чувствую, что оно возвращается ко мне, когда ты приходишь.
bulgarian: And yet, I feel it return to me whenever you seek me out.

english: The heart is a funny thing. I know it resides here, in my chest...
french: Le cœur est une chose étrange. Je sais qu'il est là, dans ma poitrine...
russian: Странная вещь — сердце. Я знаю, что оно живёт у меня в груди...
bulgarian: The heart is a funny thing. I know it resides here, in my chest...

english: This =Breath of Flame= must have been pressed into it centuries ago.
french: Quelqu'un a dû y mettre cette =soufflefeu= à sécher il y a des siècles.
russian: Должно быть, этот =огнецвет= хранился в нём многие века.
bulgarian: This =Breath of Flame= must have been pressed into it centuries ago.

english: The sight of it filled my chest with so many feelings, all at once...
french: En la voyant, j'ai ressenti comme un feu d'artifice d'émotions...
russian: От его вида моё сердце сразу заполнили самые разные чувства...
bulgarian: The sight of it filled my chest with so many feelings, all at once...

english: Just as you do.
french: Comme quand je te vois.
russian: От твоего вида так же.
bulgarian: Just as you do.

english: Please... I would like you to have it.
french: Je voudrais te l'offrir... S'il te plaît.
russian: Пожалуйста... Я хочу, чтобы он был у тебя.
bulgarian: Please... I would like you to have it.

english: [Ari], I made a wonderful discovery while reading a scroll the other day.
french: [Ari], j'ai fait une découverte merveilleuse l'autre jour, en lisant un parchemin.
russian: [Ari], недавно, во время чтения одного свитка, я обнаружил чудесную находку.
bulgarian: [Ari], I made a wonderful discovery while reading a scroll the other day.

english: It would seem that expressing affection in this form is as pleasant as it is unique.
french: Il semblerait qu'exprimer son affection sous cette forme est aussi agréable qu'unique.
russian: Кажется, этот способ выражать расположение и приятен и уникален.
bulgarian: It would seem that expressing affection in this form is as pleasant as it is unique.

english: I look forward to exploring more such experiences with you.
french: J'ai hâte de partager d'autres expériences de ce genre avec toi.
russian: Я рассчитываю испытать подобный опыт с тобой ещё не раз.
bulgarian: I look forward to exploring more such experiences with you.

english: After the kiss we shared, I have been thinking...
french: Après notre baiser, j'ai beaucoup réfléchi...
russian: После нашего поцелуя я стал размышлять...
bulgarian: After the kiss we shared, I have been thinking...

english: Try as I might, the end result was always... different than I expected.
french: J'ai eu beau essayer, le résultat était toujours... différent de ce lui espéré.
russian: Как я ни старался, финальный результат всегда... отличался от того, на что я рассчитывал.
bulgarian: Try as I might, the end result was always... different than I expected.

english: $Essence$ will appear in the form of $small purple orbs$ as you go about your day. Try activities such as $Farming$, $Fishing$, and $Mining$. You'll be sure to find some.
french: L'$essence$ apparaîtra sous la forme d'une $petite sphère mauve$ au cours de tes activités quotidiennes. Si tu pratiques, l'$agriculture$, la $pêche$ et l'$extraction minière$, tu en trouveras sûrement.
russian: $Эссенция$ будет иногда появляться вокруг тебя в виде $маленьких фиолетовых шариков$. Попробуй $выращивать растения$, $ловить рыбу$ и $ломать камни$, тогда точно её найдёшь.
bulgarian: $Есенция$ ще се появява под формата на $малки лилави кълба$, докато вършиш всекидневните си дейности. Опитай със $земеделие$, $риболов$ и $копаене$. Със сигурност ще откриеш.

english: Use this $Shrine$ when you want to offer your collected $Essence$. In exchange, I will use my restored power to grant you $Skill Perks$.
french: Sers-toi de cet $autel$ pour faire offrande de l'$essence$ que tu auras récoltée. J'utiliserai en échange mon pouvoir récupéré pour t'octroyer des $bonus de compétences$.
russian: Собранную $эссенцию$ ты можешь приность в это $святилище$. За восстановление моих сил я дарую тебе $навыки$.
bulgarian: Използвай това $светилище$, когато искаш да принесеш събраната $Есенция$. В замяна ще използвам възвърнатата си сила, за да ти дам $умения$.

english: These $Skill Perks$ will serve to make life easier for you.
french: Ces $bonus de compétences$ serviront à te faciliter la vie.
russian: Эти $навыки$ облегчат твою жизнь.
bulgarian: Тези $умения$ ще улеснят живота ти.

english: I grow tired... Let us speak again tomorrow.
french: La fatigue me gagne... Reparlons-nous demain.
russian: Меня охватывает усталость... Завтра поговорим вновь.
bulgarian: Изморявам се... Нека поговорим пак утре.

english: Ah, greetings mortal. The time has come for you to begin collecting $Essence$.
french: Ah, je te salue, <he>mortel</he><she>mortelle</she><they>mortel·le</they>. Le moment est venu pour toi de commencer à récolter l'$essence$.
russian: Приветствую тебя, смертный. Пришло время начать сбор $эссенции$.
bulgarian: А, поздрави, смъртни. Време е да започнеш да събираш $Есенция$.

english: $Essence$ will appear in the form of $small purple orbs$ as you go about your day. Try activities such as $Farming$, $Fishing$, and $Mining$. You'll be sure to find some.
french: L'$essence$ apparaîtra sous la forme d'une $petite sphère mauve$ au cours de tes activités quotidiennes. Si tu pratiques, l'$agriculture$, la $pêche$ et l'$extraction minière$, tu en trouveras sûrement.
russian: $Эссенция$ будет иногда появляться вокруг тебя в виде $маленьких фиолетовых шариков$. Попробуй $выращивать растения$, $ловить рыбу$ и $ломать камни$, тогда точно её найдёшь.
bulgarian: $Есенция$ ще се появява под формата на $малки лилави кълба$, докато вършиш всекидневните си дейности. Опитай със $земеделие$, $риболов$ и $копаене$. Със сигурност ще откриеш.

english: Use this $Shrine$ when you want to offer your collected $Essence$. In exchange, I will use my restored power to grant you $Skill Perks$.
french: Sers-toi de cet $autel$ pour faire offrande de l'$essence$ que tu auras récoltée. J'utiliserai en échange mon pouvoir récupéré pour t'octroyer des $bonus de compétences$.
russian: Собранную $эссенцию$ ты можешь приность в это $святилище$. За восстановление моих сил я дарую тебе $навыки$.
bulgarian: Използвай това $светилище$, когато искаш да принесеш събраната $Есенция$. В замяна ще използвам възвърнатата си сила, за да ти дам $умения$.

english: These $Skill Perks$ will serve to make life easier for you.
french: Ces $bonus de compétences$ serviront à te faciliter la vie.
russian: Эти $навыки$ облегчат твою жизнь.
bulgarian: Тези $умения$ ще улеснят живота ти.

english: I grow tired... Let us speak again tomorrow.
french: La fatigue me gagne... Reparlons-nous demain.
russian: Меня охватывает усталость... Завтра поговорим вновь.
bulgarian: Изморявам се... Нека поговорим пак утре.

english: Ah, greetings mortal. I see you have already collected some Essence. Well done.
french: Ah, je te salue, <he>mortel</he><she>mortelle</she><they>mortel·le</they>. Je vois que tu as déjà récolté de l'$essence$. Beau travail.
russian: Приветствую тебя, смертный. Я вижу, тебе уже удалось собрать немало $эссенции$. Поздравляю.
bulgarian: А, поздрави, смъртни. Виждам, че вече имаш малко есенция. Добре.

english: I recall that humans once offered their prayers from both above and below the ground...
french: Je me souviens que jadis, les humains offraient leurs prières depuis le sous-sol comme depuis la surface.
russian: Я припоминаю: когда-то люди обращались с молитвами на земле и из-под неё...
bulgarian: Спомням си, че хората някога са отправяли молитви и над, и под земята...

english: However... that was long ago, and human lifespans are short.
french: Cependant... c'était il y a longtemps, et la durée d'une existence humaine est courte.
russian: Однако... Это было давным-давно, а людская жизнь скоротечна.
bulgarian: Но... това е било отдавна, а човешкият живот е кратък.

english: A voice inside the Mines?
french: Une voix dans les mines ?
russian: Голос в глубине шахт?
bulgarian: Глас в Мините?

english: Hmm...
french: Mmm...
russian: Хмм...
bulgarian: Хм…

english: [Ari], I ask that you investigate further. I sense it will be key to understanding the return of magic to this land.
french: Je te demande de poursuivre tes investigations, [Ari]. Je sens que c'est la clé pour comprendre le retour de la magie sur ces terres.
russian: [Ari], я прошу тебя исследовать этот вопрос. Я чувствую, что это поможет понять, как в эти земли вернулась магия.
bulgarian: [Ari], моля те, проучи това по-обстойно. Усещам, че то ще е ключът към разбирането на завръщането на магията в тази земя.

english: The earthquake... and the Mines below the town...
french: Le tremblement de terre... et les mines sous la ville...
russian: Это землетрясение... И подземные шахты под городом...
bulgarian: Земетресението… и Мините под града…

english: The Mines have been opened? Interesting...
french: Les mines ont été ouvertes ? Intéressant...
russian: Вы открыли шахты? Любопытно...
bulgarian: Мините са отворени? Интересно…

english: Keep me apprised, [Ari]. Although I feel my strength slowly increasing, my memory still lags.
french: Continue de m'informer, [Ari]. Bien que je sente mes forces revenir lentement, la mémoire me fait toujours défaut.
russian: Держи меня в курсе, [Ari]. Я чувствую, как сила медленно возвращается ко мне, однако память ещё слаба.
